ZERO `<PaletteSlugBar` template usages. `grep -c "PaletteSlugBar|slug-pill" visual/STATES.json` = 0. Quoted law: VISUAL-CONSTITUTION.md:222 "Account is one modal side Dialog opened from the Dock, not a route chassis or second main."; PROPORTION-AUDIT.md:67 (§5.2) "A card has one protagonist, one identity line, and at most one persistent action/status region." Screenshots read: visual/shots/safari-desktop-light/palettes.png and safari-mobile-dark/palettes.png show no slug pill / identity row / account affordance in the pane. git log -- the file: f2c8f565 (glass-7 adoption) modernised it AFTER a61094e3 deleted its host.
defects.mechanism: orphaned composition — a barrel export keeps the module nominally 'used', and the sole consumer reference is `import type`, which TypeScript erases; no gate fails on 'exported, typechecks, never rendered'
defects.reproduction: `grep -rn "<PaletteSlugBar" demo/` → 0 results. Load http://localhost:9000/#/palettes at any matrix; the identity region is absent (confirmed against the two Safari captures).
defects.proposedCure: Delete demo/palettes/browser/slug/ and the demo/palettes/browser/index.ts:44 re-export; retire slugBarRef from useSlugMigration.ts (returned at :121 but never re-exported by usePalettePorts.ts, so its four setError calls at :84-87 already write to null). Fold the one genuinely missing affordance — an authored, field-associated sign-in error — into the constitution's single Account Dialog under W23 with W15 supplying auth state. Do not re-home the bar; the bar is the defect.

defects.defect: The login form cannot submit. `@submit.prevent="onSlugSwitch"` is bound to the inner `<input type="search">`, not the `<form>`, because glass-ui 7.0.0's SearchBar is `inheritAttrs: false` and spreads $attrs onto its input. The `<form>` has no submit listener, so nothing calls preventDefault and a real browser performs an unprevented native form submission (GET to the current URL) that reloads the SPA and discards the typed slug.
defects.evidence: Producer source, node_modules/@mkbabb/glass-ui/dist/search.js SearchBar: `inheritAttrs: !1` … `b("input", w({ ref_key:"inputRef", ref:s, type:"search" }, o.value, {...}))` where `o` = $attrs minus class. Probe output (probes/submit.test.ts, probes/submit2.test.ts): `[dom] form attrs = data-v-e6a0327e,class,data-surface` / `[dom] input attrs = type,placeholder,class,value` / `[A] submit on <form> -> switchSlug emitted = null` / `[B] submit on <input> -> switchSlug emitted = [["brave-amber-quiet-fox",false]]` / `[btn0] type="submit" aria-label="Sign in with slug"` `[slot] buttons render inside <form>? = 2` / `Error: Not implemented: HTMLFormElement.prototype.requestSubmit` / `[click] switchSlug emitted = null` / `[click] slugEditMode still true = true`. Source: PaletteSlugBar.vue:5-15.
defects.mechanism: producer-contract misuse — SearchBar is a field, not a form host, but accepts tag="form" without objecting, so a consumer's @submit silently relocates onto an element that can never fire that event; `onSubmit` is a legal fall-through attr so typechecking cannot catch it
defects.reproduction: npx vitest run --testTimeout=60000 --config probes/vitest.config.ts probes/submit.test.ts — dispatch a real cancelable `submit` Event on the rendered <form>: switchSlug is NOT emitted. Dispatch the same event on the <input>: it IS emitted. Then probes/submit2.test.ts clicks the genuine type="submit" button and switchSlug stays unemitted with edit mode still open.
defects.proposedCure: Two altitudes. Producer (glass-ui BH/BI relay per the standing edict): SearchBar must either refuse tag="form" or route non-input listeners to its root. Consumer: a credential entry is not a search field at all — the Account Dialog should own a real `<form @submit.prevent>` around a real `<input autocomplete=…>`, exactly the idiom SlugEditLayer.vue:76-100 already ships correctly.

defects.defect: The failure state is broken three independent ways: (a) it overlaps the following content by 8px at every viewport; (b) `whitespace-nowrap` on an absolutely positioned box means a real server message is 758px wide inside a 286px host and is silently clipped, discarding the actionable half; (c) it is a color-only failure with no role, no aria-live, no aria-invalid on the field and no aria-describedby association — so it disappears entirely in forced-colors and is never announced.
defects.evidence: Source PaletteSlugBar.vue:124-126 (`absolute left-0 -bottom-4 text-mono-small text-destructive whitespace-nowrap`) and :221 (`else slugError.value = msg || "Login failed"` — arbitrary server string). Real-cascade measurement, probes/geom.mjs, invariant across three arms: `### desktop-1440 errOverlapsFollowing: 8 errOverflowsBarBox: 16` / `### mobile-390 errOverlapsFollowing: 8 errOverflowsBarBox: 16` / `### narrow-320 errOverlapsFollowing: 8 errOverflowsBarBox: 16` (root min-h-9 + measured marginBottom "8px" vs bottom:-1rem and a 19.59px line box). probes/geom2.mjs against the real host: `### narrow-320 { hostTag: "DIV.pane-header.px-4.sm:px-6", hostWidth: 286, shortErrW: 267.08, shortErrOverflowsHost: -2.92, longErrW: 758.16, longErrOverflowsHost: 488.16, longErrOverflowsViewport: 471.16 }`; document.scrollWidth stayed 320, so an ancestor clips. probes/mount.test.ts: `[error] tree has role=alert|status = false` / `aria-live = false` / `aria-invalid = false` / `aria-describedby = false`. Quoted law: VISUAL-CONSTITUTION.md:83 "Selected, failed, pending, withdrawn and disabled states are never color-only. Role, accessible name, state/value and associated error/status are explicit."; PROPORTION-AUDIT.md §5.3.
defects.mechanism: unowned failure surface — an absolutely positioned, non-wrapping, unassociated text node used as an error affordance; the collision axis is reserved at half the required amount and unbounded transport copy is piped straight into a fixed-width nowrap box
defects.reproduction: node probes/geom.mjs (8px overlap, all three arms) and node probes/geom2.mjs (488px host overflow for a realistic API title, 2.92px of slack for the SHORTEST authored string); npx vitest run --config probes/vitest.config.ts probes/mount.test.ts for the missing a11y attributes.
defects.proposedCure: Retire the absolute box entirely. The error belongs in normal flow beneath the field, wrapping, `role="alert"`, with aria-invalid + aria-describedby on the input, and copy authored by the app rather than passed through from the transport. PROPORTION-AUDIT.md PR-08 already owns this exact row ("Pending/failure/export/recovery truth only transient → ADD-AFFORDANCE, Primary W23").

defects.defect: The slug pill paints the raw live picked color directly onto text AND border with no contrast certification, while nine sibling sites consume the ratified `useSafeAccentFn` D6 idiom. On the plate the pill sits on, 82.2–93.2% of a realistic pick population falls below the app's own 5.75 text floor; median contrast is 1.98–2.60:1 and worst cases are 1.00:1 — literally invisible, boundary included.
defects.evidence: Source PaletteSlugBar.vue:47-52 `:style="{ color: cssColorOpaque, borderColor: cssColorOpaque }"`. The repo already documents this exact bug at ProfileSection.vue:22-31: "the raw pick as text/border measured ≤1.28:1 on the real menu ground for roughly half of all picks per scheme." `grep -rln "useSafeAccentFn" demo/` lists 9 files; PaletteSlugBar is not among them. Measured sweep (probes/ink-sweep.test.ts, n=1728 per arm, WCAG 2.x recomputed independently, surface via the app's own resolveSurfaceLightness, floor = TEXT_CONTRAST_FLOOR+CERTIFY_HEADROOM=5.75): `[SWEEP light-ambient-0.75] restingL=0.8955 n=1728 fail(<5.75)=1421 (82.2%) median=2.60:1 worst=1.00:1`; `[SWEEP light-ambient-0.51] fail=1610 (93.2%) median=1.98:1 worst=1.00:1`; `[SWEEP dark-ambient-0.35] fail=1193 (69.0%)`; `[SWEEP dark-ambient-0.22] fail=1104 (63.9%)`; certifyAccentInk would MOVE 87.2–97.5% of picks. Concrete case: `[CASE] RAW oklch(0.80 0.15 60) -> 1.42:1 (PaletteSlugBar.vue:49)` vs `[CASE] CERT oklch(44.48% 0.104 60deg) -> 5.75:1 (ProfileSection.vue:31)`. Live corroboration: geom.mjs read the pill's computed color back as the unmodified `oklch(0.8 0.15 60)`. Quoted law: VISUAL-CONSTITUTION.md:82.
defects.mechanism: missed D6 certification — the fix landed at nine sites but not at the orphan, because the orphan is invisible; raw accent applied to both ink and border means the pill loses text and boundary together
defects.reproduction: Set environment to "node" in probes/vitest.config.ts, then `npx vitest run --testTimeout=60000 --config probes/vitest.config.ts probes/ink-sweep.test.ts`.
defects.proposedCure: No new mechanism to invent: adopt `useSafeAccentFn("resting")`, the ratified D6 idiom already wired at nine sites. Architecturally the site should not survive at all (D-1), so the real cure is that the Account Dialog inherits the certified ink path by construction rather than each site remembering to opt in.

defects.defect: The 'Your slug' explanation is hover-only on a bare `<span>` that carries no tabindex, no role, no accessible name and no aria-expanded — unreachable by keyboard, and on coarse pointers glass-ui falls the Popover back to a CLICK root, turning the span into an operable control with no name or focus. The component also overrides the producer's 150ms hover-intent closeDelay to 0, so moving the pointer toward the panel dismisses it.
defects.evidence: Source PaletteSlugBar.vue:45-60 (`<Popover trigger="hover" :close-delay="0" :open-delay="300">` with `<span class="slug-pill cursor-help">` as the as-child trigger). Probe (probes/mount.test.ts): `[trigger] tag = SPAN` / `tabindex = null` / `role = null` / `aria-label = null` / `aria-expanded = null` / `all attrs = {"class":"slug-pill cursor-help","data-state":"closed","data-grace-area-trigger":"","style":...}`. Producer default: `grep -rn "closeDelay" node_modules/@mkbabb/glass-ui/dist/*.js` → `popover-BQGYXZyO.js:23: closeDelay: { default: 150 }`. Pointer adaptation in the same file: `matchMedia("(pointer: coarse)").matches` gates `trigger === "hover"`, falling back to the click PopoverRoot on touch. Quoted law: PROPORTION-AUDIT.md PR-07 "Hover-only/unlabeled controls and invisible drag state → ADD-AFFORDANCE / REMOVE" and §5.5 "Decorative controls and operable ornaments without names are forbidden."
defects.mechanism: PR-07 hover-only affordance plus a per-instance override of a producer-tuned default (edict-5 failure mode); as-child forwards data-state and handlers but never synthesizes focusability on a non-interactive element
defects.reproduction: npx vitest run --testTimeout=60000 --config probes/vitest.config.ts probes/mount.test.ts — the rendered trigger's full attribute set contains no tabindex/role/aria-label/aria-expanded, so Tab can never reach it and AT announces nothing.
defects.proposedCure: Apply PR-07's ordering — "Subtraction precedes explanation" (§5.6). A slug does not need a hover essay beside it; identity is explained once, as prose, in the Account Dialog. If any trigger survives it is a named `<button>` and it keeps the producer's delays rather than overriding them.

defects.defect: Every operable target in the component is below the visual audit harness's own 24px floor or the 44px touch floor: the three-dot account menu is 22.00×22.00, the Login pill 89.08×29.59, the slug pill (a click trigger on coarse pointers) 198.94×25.59 — invariant across 1440/390/320.
defects.evidence: Real-cascade measurement, probes/geom.mjs, identical at all three arms: `dots: { w: 22, h: 22 }` (source :84, `p-1` + `w-3.5 h-3.5`), `login: { w: 89.08, h: 29.59 }` (source :71-78, `px-3 py-1 text-mono-small`), `pill: { w: 198.94, h: 25.59 }` (source :47, `.slug-pill` = `px-2 py-0.5` at foundation.css:585). The floor is the audit's own: docs/tranches/V/megatranche/audit/visual/capture.mjs — `.filter((m) => m.w < 24 || m.h < 24)`. Quoted law: PROPORTION-AUDIT.md PR-12 "Touch padding bloats/misaligns visual glyphs → TIGHTEN, Primary W18" and §5.7 "Visual glyph size, operable target size and layout reservation are separate quantities."
defects.mechanism: PR-12 — visible chrome and operable seat conflated; the 14px glyph is correct but the hit seat was never separated from it
defects.reproduction: node probes/geom.mjs — the three-dot trigger measures 22×22 in the real cascade at 1440, 390 and 320, i.e. it would be counted as a smallTapTargets defect by capture.mjs on any route that rendered it.
defects.proposedCure: Per §5.7, grow the seat invisibly (pseudo-element / negative-margin hit area or the producer's own compact control seat, e.g. glass-ui DockControl which SlugEditLayer already uses) while leaving the 14px glyph and the pill's optical size untouched. Do not inflate visible chrome to reach the floor.

defects.defect: The pending state is structurally unrenderable: onSlugSwitch's try block contains zero awaits, so slugSwitching goes true→false inside one synchronous block while :215 simultaneously unmounts the form. The Loader2 spinner and the 'Signing in…' accessible name can never be observed. Even if reachable, the global prefers-reduced-motion guard freezes animate-spin at frame 1, leaving a static circle indistinguishable from the idle arrow.
defects.evidence: Source PaletteSlugBar.vue:198-225 (spinner at :26, aria-label at :24, slugEditMode=false at :215, finally at :222-224). Measured: `[unused] awaits inside onSlugSwitch try-block = 0`. DOM-driven confirmation (probes/pending.test.ts) sampling every microtask and macrotask boundary around a real submit: `[dom] spinner presence timeline = before-submit:false  sync-after-trigger:false  microtask-1:false  microtask-2:false  after-await-trigger:false  after-nextTick:false  after-macrotask:false`. PRM guard, demo/styles/animations.css:183-192: `@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { *, *::before, *::after { animation-duration: 0.01ms !important; animation-iteration-count: 1 !important; ...`. Quoted law: VISUAL-CONSTITUTION.md:83 — pending is "never color-only".
defects.mechanism: unreachable designed state — the component owns a pending flag for work it delegates synchronously to an un-awaited parent handler; the spinner is the only pending signal and it is both unreachable and PRM-fragile
defects.reproduction: npx vitest run --testTimeout=60000 --config probes/vitest.config.ts probes/pending.test.ts — .animate-spin is absent at every sampled boundary around a real form submit.
defects.proposedCure: Pending state must be owned by whoever owns the async work. The Account Dialog should hold the auth request (W15's outbox state) and drive a producer pending affordance that carries a text/state signal, not motion alone, so it survives prefers-reduced-motion and forced-colors.

defects.defect: Superseded legacy error-branching is retained (409/404/429 matched against message SUBSTRINGS — the exact mechanism the repo already ruled broken and replaced with typed ApiProblem.status), and it is doubly dead because emit() is synchronous and can never throw an ApiProblem. Separately, the credential normalizer looksLikeSlug + normalizeTokenInput is duplicated byte-for-byte with the live SlugEditLayer.
defects.evidence: Source PaletteSlugBar.vue:216-221. The ruling it ignores, quoted from demo/palettes/useSlugMigration.ts:78-87: "S.W2 W2-6: branch on the typed `ApiProblem.status`, not `.message` substrings — the server titles (\"Already logged in as this user\", \"User not found\", \"Rate limit exceeded\") never contain \"409\"/\"404\"/\"429\", so those branches matched nothing and the authored copy below never showed." Duplication proof: `diff <(sed -n '184,196p' demo/palettes/browser/slug/PaletteSlugBar.vue) <(sed -n '25,37p' demo/shell/dock/layers/SlugEditLayer.vue) && echo IDENTICAL` → `IDENTICAL: looksLikeSlug + normalizeTokenInput duplicated byte-for-byte`. Measured awaits-in-try = 0 (see D-7) proves the catch is unreachable.
defects.mechanism: legacy dual path — two live spellings of one decision, the superseded one retained in the invisible copy; and the ADMIN_TOKEN= unwrapper forked across two trees
defects.reproduction: Run the pasted diff command from the repo root: exit status 0, output IDENTICAL. Read useSlugMigration.ts:78-87 for the ruling that the retained branch violates.
defects.proposedCure: Delete the substring branches outright (edict 2: no legacy, no dual paths). Lift looksLikeSlug and normalizeTokenInput to one owner — a single auth-grammar module consumed by both the Account Dialog and SlugEditLayer. Admin-token parsing is the last place in the app that should be forked.

defects.defect: An admin secret token is typed into a hardcoded `type="search"` field with no autocomplete, autocapitalize, autocorrect, spellcheck or inputmode. iOS Safari capitalises the first character by default, and the admin path at :213 forwards the token with its original casing, so a correct token typed on iPhone fails silently. The placeholder says 'enter slug...' while the parser accepts ADMIN_TOKEN=<secret>.
defects.evidence: Probe: `[dom] input attrs = type,placeholder,class,value` — exactly four attributes. type is producer-hardcoded: node_modules/@mkbabb/glass-ui/dist/search.js — `b("input", w({ ref_key:"inputRef", ref:s, type:"search" }, ...))`. Source: normalizeTokenInput at :188-196 explicitly parses `/^ADMIN_TOKEN\s*=\s*(.+)$/i`; :204 lowercases only the slug path (`normalizeTokenInput(raw).toLowerCase()`); :213 emits `isAdmin ? normalizeTokenInput(raw) : normalized` — the admin arm keeps original casing. Placeholder :12 = "enter slug..."; the live sibling SlugEditLayer.vue:84 = "enter slug or token...".
defects.mechanism: credential hygiene — a search field pressed into service as a credential input; type=search specifically feeds UA search/datalist history, and the absent mobile input attributes let the platform mutate a secret before it is read
defects.reproduction: npx vitest run --config probes/vitest.config.ts probes/submit.test.ts — the rendered input exposes only type,placeholder,class,value. On iOS Safari, autocapitalize defaults to sentences, so a token entered as `abc…` is submitted as `Abc…` through :213 and rejected, with no announced error (D-3c).
defects.proposedCure: Credential entry belongs in the Account Dialog with a real `<input>` the consumer controls: explicit autocomplete, autocapitalize="none", autocorrect="off", spellcheck="false", and copy that names what the field accepts. If the producer field is reused, glass-ui must expose `type`/input-attribute pass-through (BH/BI relay item).

defects.defect: Motion is ad hoc rather than tokenized: two different press amplitudes in one component (active:scale-95 vs the arbitrary-value active:scale-[0.98]); one control uses bare `transition-colors` while five use `transition-colors duration-fast`; in every case the transition property list is colors-only so the scale press is an untransitioned snap; and a hardcoded setTimeout(…, 50) gates the mode swap on a magic number shorter than the --duration-fast (200ms) exit it claims to wait for, and is pure dead latency under prefers-reduced-motion.
defects.evidence: Source: active:scale-95 at :73 and :84; active:scale-[0.98] at :91, :98, :106, :113. Bare `transition-colors` at :73; `transition-colors duration-fast` at :84/:91/:98/:106/:113. setTimeout at :176-181 with the comment "Delay to let the Popover fully close before swapping to input mode". Token value from the glass-ui :root dump: `--duration-fast: 0.2s`. PRM guard collapses transition-duration to 0.01ms (animations.css:183-192). Quoted law: VISUAL-CONSTITUTION.md:139 "Spatial continuity uses one producer-owned glass-ui spring register."
defects.mechanism: ad-hoc motion — press feedback and sequencing expressed as literals rather than through the producer register; the delay is coupled to an animation duration it does not read
defects.reproduction: NONE — hypothesis-free static reading of the six class strings and the token value; no runtime repro attempted because the component never renders. The token arithmetic (50ms gate vs 200ms --duration-fast) is exact.
defects.proposedCure: One press treatment, taken from the glass-ui spring register, applied at the producer control level (DockControl / Button already carry it — SlugEditLayer gets this for free). Replace the setTimeout with the Transition's own after-leave hook so focus lands when the exit actually completes, which is also correct under PRM. Note: the component's `vj-morph` Transition usage IS correct and must be preserved, not deleted (edict 6).

defects.defect: Type jurisdiction is violated in both directions against the closed matrix: the control label 'Login' is rendered as text-mono-small font-bold (Fira Code, bold — the value/code/provenance role), and the help paragraph is rendered as text-caption, which is not an admitted semantic role at all.
defects.evidence: Source :73 (`text-mono-small font-bold` on the Login button) and :56 (`text-caption` on the help copy). Measured live in the real cascade (probes/geom.mjs): `login: { fs: "14px", ff: "\"Fira Code\"" }`. Quoted law: VISUAL-CONSTITUTION.md §4 — "control or label, including dropdown options → text-small, Plus Jakarta Sans, non-bold"; "prose/help → text-prose"; "This matrix is closed across all eighteen compositions." Restated as law at PROPORTION-AUDIT.md §5.13. (The slug itself in text-mono-small is CORRECT — it is a value.)
defects.mechanism: closed type matrix — a verb given the provenance voice, and help prose given an unlisted rung
defects.reproduction: node probes/geom.mjs — the Login control's computed fontFamily reads "Fira Code" at 14px in the live cascade.
defects.proposedCure: Login → text-small, Plus Jakarta Sans, non-bold. Help copy → text-prose. Enforce at the producer Button/menu-item level rather than per instance, so the matrix is structural instead of remembered.

defects.defect: Dead public API surface: `hasSavedPalettes` is a REQUIRED prop with zero uses, forcing every host to compute and pass a discarded value; `copy: []` is a declared emit that is never emitted (the component calls writeClipboard itself, so a host can never observe, announce or confirm the copy); and a local `const isAdmin` shadows the destructured prop of the same name one function away.
defects.evidence: Measured (probes/mount.test.ts): `[unused] 'hasSavedPalettes' occurrences outside its declaration = 0`; `[unused] emit("copy") call sites = 0  / $emit('copy') = 0`; `[unused] declared emits = copy DECLARED`. Source: prop declared required at :150 (no `?`); emit declared at :155; writeClipboard called directly at :169; shadowing const at :205 vs the destructured prop at :147. Contrast with the live sibling ProfileSection.vue:77, which emits `copySlug` upward.
defects.mechanism: dead public surface — a component contract advertising obligations and events it does not honour
defects.reproduction: npx vitest run --config probes/vitest.config.ts probes/mount.test.ts — the D-d case counts zero occurrences of hasSavedPalettes outside its declaration and zero copy emit call sites.
defects.proposedCure: The surface should be deleted with the component (D-1). In the Account Dialog, clipboard writes emit upward so the owning surface can announce the result durably (VISUAL-CONSTITUTION §5: "Persistent operation state stays with the entity/workspace... a transient flourish never carries the only truth"); no unused required props; no shadowed identifiers.

defects.defect: Reaches past the design system and then styles per instance: four dropdown rows are hand-rolled from a ~110-character utility string repeated verbatim inside a Popover, when glass-ui already ships DropdownMenu/DropdownMenuContent/DropdownMenuItem/DropdownMenuLabel/DropdownMenuSeparator and the live sibling uses them; the trigger even declares aria-haspopup="dialog" for what is a menu. The admin pill also uses Tailwind color utilities where the sibling uses the shared recipe's documented :style contract.
defects.evidence: Source :89-118 — four buttons each carrying `class="flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-1.5 text-small font-display rounded-sm hover:bg-accent active:scale-[0.98] active:bg-accent/70 transition-colors duration-fast cursor-pointer w-full text-left focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring/40"`. aria-haspopup="dialog" at :84. Contrast: ProfileSection.vue:70-90 uses `<DropdownMenuItem class="text-small gap-2 cursor-pointer">` per row. Divergent pill idiom: PaletteSlugBar.vue:65 (`text-muted-foreground border-muted-foreground`) vs MobileMenuDropdown.vue:67 (`style="border-color: var(--muted-foreground); color: var(--muted-foreground)"`), against the recipe's own comment at demo/styles/foundation.css:585 — "Consumers set `color` / `border-color` per-instance via :style". Untested rider: foundation.css:746 bumps .slug-pill to border-width: 2px under prefers-reduced-transparency.
defects.mechanism: design-system boundary — a producer primitive that already exists is re-implemented in consumer utility soup, and one shared recipe grows two consumer idioms
defects.reproduction: NONE — hypothesis-free static reading; the four repeated class strings and the sibling's DropdownMenuItem usage are directly comparable at the cited lines.
defects.proposedCure: Consume glass-ui DropdownMenu* (edict 4: reuse existing component-type names), which also fixes the semantics — a command menu is a menu, not a dialog popover. Keep the .slug-pill recipe's single documented contract (:style) at every consumer rather than forking a Tailwind spelling.

defects.defect: The component has zero coverage in every state matrix the audit produced: /palettes is absent from forced-colors-desktop, rtl-desktop and zoom-200-desktop, STATES.json has zero hits, and the component appears in none of the 60 Safari captures. Eleven designed interaction states have never been rendered once; four states (focused, overflowing/truncated, RTL, forced-colors) were never designed at all.
defects.evidence: `ls visual/shots/forced-colors-desktop/ visual/shots/rtl-desktop/ visual/shots/zoom-200-desktop/` → adminusers, blob, browse, gradient, picker (+picker-postload) only; no palettes.png in any of the three. `grep -c "PaletteSlugBar|slug-pill" visual/STATES.json` = 0. Never-designed states with source coordinates: focused — the pill trigger has no tabindex (D-5 probe); overflowing — whitespace-nowrap on an absolute box at :124 (D-3b); RTL — `left-0` at :124 is a physical inset and the slug is not LTR-isolated, against VISUAL-CONSTITUTION §6.1 ("logical inline/block direction follows the document"; "CSS strings, hex, slugs, IDs and provenance render in LTR-isolated spans"); forced-colors — the error's only signal is text-destructive (D-3c); zoom — --type-small is a vw clamp while -bottom-4 is a fixed rem, so the measured 8px collision worsens as text grows.
defects.mechanism: unobserved by construction — a component off every route cannot appear in any state matrix, so its unhandled states are invisible to the very audit designed to find them
defects.reproduction: ls the three state-matrix shot directories (pasted above) and grep STATES.json; /palettes appears in none.
defects.proposedCure: Two things. (1) Add /palettes to the forced-colors, RTL and zoom-200 matrices — its absence is a harness gap independent of this component. (2) Add a render-reachability census to the mega-tranche's born-RED set: a gate that fails on 'exported, typechecks, never rendered'. D-2, D-4, D-7 and D-8 are each a fix that landed everywhere except here, or a regression that landed only here; every one was invisible for the same reason.

result.axis: CHALLENGE-C — implementation defects · demo/palettes/browser/slug/PaletteSlugBar.vue
result.modelObserved: Opus 5 — exact model id `claude-opus-5[1m]` (1M-context variant). Declared at spawn, not inherited.
result.strongestDefect: C-2 — `@submit.prevent` is bound to glass-ui `SearchBar`'s inner `<input>`, never to the `<form>` root (`inheritAttrs:false` re-targets `$attrs`). Proven in jsdom against the real shipped glass-ui 7 component: a bubbling, cancelable `submit` dispatched on the `<form>` fires the handler **0** times with `defaultPrevented: false`; dispatched on the `<input>` it fires **1** time. So `onSlugSwitch` can never run and nothing calls `preventDefault()` — the browser performs the native GET submission. Measured in WebKit against the live SPA: `http://localhost:9000/#/palettes?...` → `http://localhost:9000/?#/palettes?...`, `navigated: true`, and the injected node did not survive (`DOM survived: false`) — a full document replacement. The component's one job — log in with a slug — cannot execute, and attempting it destroys the document and every unsaved in-memory palette. No repo gate sees it: `vue-tsc EXIT=0`, `eslint EXIT=0`, and deleting the `@submit.prevent` binding outright would change no observable behaviour.
result.negativeProof: N/A — verdict is DEFECTIVE. (Negatives that WERE established are recorded as C-25 and in the hazard sweep: prop-shadowing at line 205 does not mis-compile — `@vue/compiler-sfc` output keeps it a local and rewrites only genuine prop reads to `__props.*`; `defineExpose({slugEditMode})` IS ref-unwrapped in the public instance type — `vue-tsc` emits `TS2551: Property 'value' does not exist on type 'boolean'`; and the file is CLEAN on rAF (zero `requestAnimationFrame`), WebGL, `ValueUnit` nesting, `defineModel` stale reads, `parseCssColor`, listener/observer leaks, unbounded growth, `verbatimModuleSyntax`, and deleted animations.)

defects.defect: `@submit.prevent="onSlugSwitch"` on `<SearchBar tag="form">` binds to SearchBar's inner `<input type="search">`, not the `<form>` root, because glass-ui 7 SearchBar sets `inheritAttrs:false` and spreads `$attrs` (minus `class`) onto the input. The submit handler can never fire and nothing calls preventDefault, so activating the login form performs a native GET submission that replaces the document.
defects.evidence: demo/palettes/browser/slug/PaletteSlugBar.vue:5-15 (`tag="form"` + `@submit.prevent`). Vendor source `node_modules/@mkbabb/glass-ui/dist/search.js`: `$ = C({ inheritAttrs: !1, __name: "SearchBar", … o = g(() => { let { class: e, ...t } = a; return t; }) … b("input", w({ ref_key:"inputRef", ref: s, type:"search" }, o.value, {...}))`. jsdom probe against the real shipped component — `root tag: FORM / input present: true search / slot button in form: true / after form submit -> handler calls: 0  event.defaultPrevented: false / after input submit -> handler calls: 1`. WebKit live-SPA probe — `url before: http://localhost:9000/#/palettes?space=lab&color=lab(92%25+88.8+20+/+82.7%25)` → `url after : http://localhost:9000/?#/palettes?...`, `navigated: true`, `DOM survived (false = document replaced/reloaded): false`.
defects.mechanism: A design-system component's attribute-fallthrough contract was assumed rather than read; `tag="form"` makes SearchBar LOOK like a form element while `inheritAttrs:false` silently re-routes every listener to the inner input. Collateral from the same mechanism: `@keydown.escape.stop` DOES work — because keydown fires on the input, exactly where $attrs landed. Two listeners on the same wrong element; one survives by luck.
defects.reproduction: `node scratchpad/searchbar-submit.mjs` (jsdom + real @mkbabb/glass-ui@7.0.0 SearchBar, tag="form", onSubmit listener, type=submit button in the default slot; dispatch `new Event("submit",{bubbles:true,cancelable:true})` on the form, then on the input). `node scratchpad/probe3.mjs` (WebKit vs live http://localhost:9000/#/palettes: inject `<form><input type=search><button type=submit></form>`, focus the input, press Enter, compare page.url() and DOM identity).
defects.proposedCure: Never hang form semantics off a design-system input. Own the `<form>` in the consumer — `<form @submit.prevent="…"><SearchBar tag="div" …/><Button type="submit"/></form>` — which is exactly the idiom SlugEditLayer.vue:76-79 already uses. Better still (edict 4): give glass-ui's SearchBar a first-class `@submit` emit so `tag="form"` becomes honest, and relay to the glass-ui BH inbox — `tag="form"` + `inheritAttrs:false` is a trap for every future consumer.

defects.defect: The component is mounted on zero routes and has zero value-position importers; consequently `useSlugMigration`'s `slugBarRef` is never bound and all four `setError` calls are permanent no-ops — a failed slug login produces NO user-visible feedback anywhere in the live app.
defects.evidence: `grep -rn "SlugBar" demo/ --exclude-dir=node_modules` returns only: browser/index.ts:44 (barrel), browser/slug/index.ts:3 (barrel), useSlugMigration.ts:6 (`import type` — erased), :30/:84-87/:121. Zero `<PaletteSlugBar` tags. `grep -rn "browser/index\|from \".*browser\"" demo/` → no output, so even the re-exporting barrel is dead. usePalettePorts.ts:79-89 destructures only `migration.onRegenerateSlug`/`onSlugSwitch` — `slugBarRef` reaches no port. Provenance: `git log --oneline -S'<PaletteSlugBar' --all` → `95993197 refactor(T.W0 · lane t-legacy-sweep)`; `git show 95993197` deletes the sole mounter `PaletteDialog/components/PaletteControlsBar.vue` (hunk `-        <PaletteSlugBar ref="slugBarRef" …`) under its own stated law "all VERIFY-DEAD-FIRST (grep all imports before delete)". demo/styles/foundation.css:580 records "data-state cascade died with PaletteDialog.vue at T.W0-3, CC-6." Live WebKit repro: `C · error text visible: []`, `C · slug before/after: null / null`. Visual receipt: docs/.../visual/shots/safari-desktop-light/palettes.png shows identity only as the dock `Login` pill — no slug bar.
defects.mechanism: An orphan left standing by a sweep whose stated precondition was precisely 'grep all importers first'; the composable's error plumbing was never re-homed onto the surviving dock surface, so the error copy authored in S.W2 reaches the screen through neither path (SlugEditLayer.vue writes its own `slugError` at lines 13/49/59-62 and NEVER renders it).
defects.reproduction: `node scratchpad/probe.mjs` step C — WebKit, http://localhost:9000/#/palettes, click dock Login, type `zzzz-zzzz-zzzz-zzzz`, press Enter, wait 2.5s, then scan every leaf p/span/div for /not found|failed|already signed|too many|error/i → `[]`.
defects.proposedCure: Delete `demo/palettes/browser/slug/` and the `browser/index.ts:44` line; delete `slugBarRef` from useSlugMigration. Make the session port's `onSlugSwitch` return `Promise<void>` so the RENDERING surface owns and displays its own failure — the composable must stop reaching through a template ref into a view. One slug surface, one owner (edict 1 + edict 2).

defects.defect: `const isAdmin = !looksLikeSlug(normalized)` makes the ADMIN branch the catch-all: any input that is not exactly four lowercase hyphenated words is submitted as an admin token, and the parent's admin branch first destroys the user's persisted identity. `useAdminAuth.login()` performs no validation at all.
defects.evidence: PaletteSlugBar.vue:184-186, :205, :213. useSlugMigration.ts:51-57 `if (isAdmin) { deps.clearUserSlug(); deps.adminLogin(value); setActiveTab("saved"); return; }`. demo/platform/auth/useAdminAuth.ts:34-37 `function login(token){ adminToken.value = token; safeSetItem(localStorage, STORAGE_KEY, token); }` with `isAuthenticated = computed(() => !!adminToken.value)` — no server round-trip. Server slug shape api/src/modules/session/slugWords.ts:84-90 = `${adj}-${verb}-${color}-${animal}`, all words `[a-z]+` (node scan: the only non-[a-z]+ literals in the file are `node:crypto`, `./repository/user.js`, `findBySlug`, and an error string). LIVE repro through the byte-identical twin: `D · typo'd 3-word slug -> palette-admin-token: "brisk-leaping-azure" {"hasAdminPill":true,"snippet":"→ Palettes Tools admin @mbabb …"}`.
defects.mechanism: One text field asked to carry two disjoint credential types, disambiguated by a NEGATED shape test that reads 'unrecognisable' as 'privileged'. Latent in this component behind C-2; byte-identical and LIVE in SlugEditLayer.vue:25-27,39-66.
defects.reproduction: `node scratchpad/probe.mjs` step D — WebKit, http://localhost:9000/#/palettes, clear `palette-admin-token`, reload, click dock Login, type `brisk-leaping-azure` (a dropped-word typo of a real 4-word slug), press Enter, then read `localStorage.getItem("palette-admin-token")`.
defects.proposedCure: Make the admin route explicit and non-inferred (a distinct affordance, or the `ADMIN_TOKEN=` prefix as the ONLY admin trigger — see C-23), and reject anything that is neither with authored copy ("That doesn't look like a slug — four words, e.g. cool-blue-fox-jump"). NEVER clear the existing session before the new credential is accepted by the server.

defects.defect: The slug input is never focused after opening edit mode: `nextTick` resolves ~0 ms after the flag flip while `<Transition mode="out-in">` holds the incoming branch for the full 200 ms leave, so `searchBarRef.value` is null and `?.` eats the focus call. There is no retry.
defects.evidence: PaletteSlugBar.vue:172-182 (`setTimeout(… , 50)` → `slugEditMode.value = true` → `nextTick(() => searchBarRef.value?.inputRef?.focus())`), :4 (`<Transition name="vj-morph" mode="out-in">`). demo/styles/animations.css:111-116 `.vj-morph-leave-active { transition: … var(--duration-fast) … }`; node_modules/@mkbabb/glass-ui/dist/styles/tokens/scheme-motion.css:1 `--duration-fast: 0.2s`. Pass-1 live rAF timeline: `insertedAtMs: 276`, `document.activeElement` never becomes the input at any of 7 samples.
defects.mechanism: A time-based guess (setTimeout 50 ms) stacked on a lifecycle fact (Transition out-in completion). Two clocks, no handshake. Compounded by the Vue 3.4 string-ref idiom (`ref<InstanceType<typeof SearchBar>|null>(null)`) instead of `useTemplateRef` — edict 7; SlugEditLayer.vue:14 already uses useTemplateRef.
defects.reproduction: Structural + token-corroborated; pass-1 captured the live rAF timeline against a `/@fs/` mount of the unmodified SFC (preserved at challenge-C-implementation.run-1.md §C-3).
defects.proposedCure: Delete the timer and the guess entirely; focus from the transition's own `@after-enter` hook via `useTemplateRef("searchBarRef")`. Pair with C-20(c) so focus is both PLACED on open and RESTORED to the trigger on cancel.

defects.defect: `slugSwitching` is set true and false inside one synchronous turn (`onSlugSwitch` is `async` with zero `await`), so Vue never flushes a render between them: the Loader2 spinner, the `aria-label="Signing in…"` in-flight name, and the `:disabled` double-submit guard are all unreachable states.
defects.evidence: PaletteSlugBar.vue:198-225 — `slugSwitching.value = true` (201), `emit("switchSlug", …)` (213), `slugEditMode.value = false` (215), `finally { slugSwitching.value = false }` (223), with no `await` anywhere in the try. Dead consumers at :23 (`:disabled="!slugInput.trim() || slugSwitching"`), :24 (`:aria-label="slugSwitching ? 'Signing in…' : …"`), :26 (`<Loader2 v-if="slugSwitching">`). Pass-1 live measurement across 5 inputs: `slugSwitchingAfterSyncCall: false`, `spinnerRenderedAnyFrame: false` for every one.
defects.mechanism: A loading flag wrapped around a FIRE-AND-FORGET emit — the real network work happens in the parent (`useSlugMigration.onSlugSwitch`, which IS async) and the child holds no handle on it. The declared `async` is vestigial.
defects.reproduction: Structural (statement order, no await in scope); pass-1 measured it 5× live via the dev instance handle (run-1.md §C-4).
defects.proposedCure: Make the port's `onSlugSwitch` return `Promise<void>` and `await` it here. One change repairs the spinner, the disabled guard, the error path (C-16) and the optimistic close (C-21). glass-ui `Button` also ships a first-class `loading` prop that this file hand-rolls.

defects.defect: The form closes optimistically: the credential is cleared and the field unmounted in the SAME synchronous turn as the emit, before the parent's async login resolves. Even with C-1 and C-2 cured, the error can never reach the field it describes, and every retry requires a full re-type.
defects.evidence:
PaletteSlugBar.vue:213-215 in order — `emit("switchSlug", …)`; `slugInput.value = ""`; `slugEditMode.value = false`. Parent resolves later: useSlugMigration.ts:74-88 (`await deps.userLogin(value)` … `slugBarRef.value?.setError(...)`). The error `

` at :124 renders OUTSIDE the ``, which is exactly why it can paint in a mode where the input no longer exists. Observable end state measured live in C-1: `C · error text visible: []` with the field already closed.
defects.mechanism: Success-path-only sequencing: the view treats a fire-and-forget emit as a completed transaction. Distinct from C-4 (flag lifetime) and from C-14 (clearing) — this is what ORPHANS the error from its field rather than merely leaving it stale.
defects.reproduction: Structural — derived from statement order at 213-215 against the async parent at useSlugMigration.ts:74-88. Live end-state captured by `node scratchpad/probe.mjs` step C.
defects.proposedCure:
The same `await` as C-4. Close the field on SUCCESS only; preserve the typed value on failure so the retry is one keystroke, not a re-type. Move the error `

` inside the edit branch so it cannot outlive its field.

defects.defect: The account menu lies about its role, has no menu semantics, and never restores focus: `aria-haspopup="dialog"` contradicts the `role="group"` glass-ui actually renders (with no aria-label); the four commands are bare `<button>`s with no role=menu/menuitem and no arrow-key navigation; and every cancel path unmounts the focused element with no focus restoration.
defects.evidence: PaletteSlugBar.vue:84 `aria-haspopup="dialog"`; :88 `<PopoverContent class="w-auto p-1 flex flex-col gap-0.5 z-popover" align="end" :side-offset="4">` — no aria-label. Vendor source node_modules/@mkbabb/glass-ui/dist/popover-BQGYXZyO.js: `"data-material":"overlay", "data-reveal":"menu", role: "group", "aria-label": t.ariaLabel`. Menu items are plain `<button>`s at :89-118. Focus: `@keydown.escape.stop="slugEditMode = false"` (:14) and the X button `@click="slugEditMode = false"` (:36) both remove the focused node via the v-if flip with no restore target. The dock's own equivalent uses DropdownMenu/DropdownMenuItem for the SAME four commands (ProfileSection.vue:53-90).
defects.mechanism: A menu hand-rolled out of a generic disclosure primitive: the ARIA was authored by hand to describe a surface the primitive renders differently, and the keyboard contract a real menu primitive supplies for free was simply not implemented.
defects.reproduction: NONE for the focus-restoration leg — the component is unmounted (C-1), so it is structural: the focused node is removed by the v-if with no receiving element. The role contradiction is read directly off the vendor source plus lines 84/88.
defects.proposedCure: Replace the hand-rolled Popover-as-menu with glass-ui `<DropdownMenu>` + `<DropdownMenuItem>` (edict 4 — reuse the existing component-type name; the dock already does). Drop the hand-written `aria-haspopup` — the primitive sets its own — and get roving focus, typeahead, Escape and reka's `onCloseAutoFocus` restoration for free.

defects.defect: The slug input has no accessible name — placeholder only, no <label>, no aria-label, no name attribute.
defects.evidence: PaletteSlugBar.vue:12 `placeholder="enter slug..."` is the only naming affordance. Pass-1 measurement on the mounted component: `inputAria: { label: null, describedby: null, invalid: null, name: null, type: "search" }`. Fails WCAG 4.1.2 (Name, Role, Value) and 3.3.2 (Labels or Instructions); the placeholder also vanishes on input, unlabelling the field for sighted users mid-typing.
defects.mechanism: Placeholder-as-label — the nameless-control class the visual REPORT counts across routes.
defects.reproduction: Pass-1 live measurement against a `/@fs/` mount of the unmodified SFC (run-1.md §C-6).
defects.proposedCure: `aria-label="Slug or admin token"` on the field — which, per C-2, is the one place SearchBar's $attrs re-routing actually helps — plus a visible label where the layout allows.

defects.defect:
The async error is never announced and never associated with the field: the error

has no role=alert / aria-live, and the input carries no aria-describedby and no aria-invalid.
defects.evidence:
PaletteSlugBar.vue:124-126 `

`. Pass-1 measurement after forcing setError: `errorP: { ariaLive: null, role: null }`; `querySelectorAll("[aria-live], [role=alert]").length === 0` across the whole component; `inputAria.describedby: null`, `inputAria.invalid: null`. Fails WCAG 4.1.3 (Status Messages) and 3.3.1 (Error Identification).
defects.mechanism: An async result rendered as static prose — the status-message contract was never wired.
defects.reproduction: Pass-1 live measurement (run-1.md §C-7).
defects.proposedCure:
`role="alert"` (or aria-live="polite") on the

, give it an id, and bind `aria-describedby` + `aria-invalid="true"` on the input while slugError is non-empty.

defects.defect: The identity pill and the only copy explaining what a slug IS are unreachable by keyboard AND by touch: a non-focusable <span> behind `<Popover trigger="hover">`, which routes to reka-ui's HoverCard whose pointer handlers are excludeTouch-wrapped and whose trigger adds no tabindex.
defects.evidence: PaletteSlugBar.vue:45-60. Measured against the live stylesheet: `"pill": { "w": 270.31, "h": 28.94 }, "spanTabIndex": -1`. glass-ui routing, dist/popover-BQGYXZyO.js: `let _ = … window.matchMedia("(pointer: coarse)").matches, v = i(() => n.trigger === "hover" && !_); E({ usesHoverRoot: v })`. reka-ui HoverCardTrigger.js: `props: { as: { default: "a" } } … onPointerenter: excludeTouch(rootContext.onOpen)($event), onPointerleave: excludeTouch(handleLeave)($event), onFocus: rootContext.onOpen(), onBlur: rootContext.onClose()` — no tabindex anywhere. So onFocus exists but the span can never receive focus, and touch is explicitly excluded.
defects.mechanism: A disclosure built on a non-interactive element: `cursor-help` promises an affordance the markup does not provide, and the chosen trigger mode is the one input modality the majority of the audited matrix (mobile Safari) cannot perform.
defects.reproduction: `node scratchpad/probe2.mjs` — inject the exact markup from lines 47-52 into the live page inside `.app-layout`, read getBoundingClientRect and `.tabIndex`. Mechanism read directly from the two vendor sources above.
defects.proposedCure: The pill is a disclosure — make it one. A real <button> (or the span with tabindex="0" + role="button") behind glass-ui Tooltip/Popover with a trigger mode that accepts focus. Reuse the existing component-type name (edict 4) rather than hand-rolling.

defects.defect: `variant="ghost"` is not a glass-ui 7 Button prop — it falls through as a junk DOM attribute while the button renders at the default filled emphasis. A pre-7.0 API residue that the W44 glass-ui-7 migration missed here, and 20 sites repo-wide.
defects.evidence: node_modules/@mkbabb/glass-ui/dist/components/button/Button.vue.d.ts: `export interface ButtonProps extends PrimitiveProps { emphasis?: ButtonEmphasis; tone?: Tone; size?: ButtonSize; iconOnly?: boolean; loading?: boolean; type?: …; disabled?: …; class?: … }` — no `variant`. PaletteSlugBar.vue:19, :31 pass `variant="ghost"`. Pass-1 measured the mounted DOM: `{ variantAttr:"ghost", emphasis:"secondary", w:27.9, h:27.9 }` ×2. Live fallthrough on a mounted sibling (`node scratchpad/probe.mjs` step A): `A · [variant] fallthrough: { "count": 2, "sample": ["BUTTON variant=outline class=button tap-squish focus-ring glass-wash …", "BUTTON variant=ghost class=button …"], "emphasisAttrs": 0 }`. Census: `grep -rn 'variant="ghost"\|variant="outline"' demo/ | wc -l` → 20, vs 2 uses of the real `emphasis` prop. Gate receipt: `npx vue-tsc -p tsconfig.demo.json --noEmit; echo EXIT=$?` → `EXIT=0`; `npx eslint demo/palettes/browser/slug/PaletteSlugBar.vue; echo ESLINT_EXIT=$?` → `ESLINT_EXIT=0`.
defects.mechanism: Vue templates admit arbitrary fallthrough attributes, so a removed prop degrades to a silent no-op that no typed or lint gate can see — the exact shape a breaking major-version migration leaves behind. The file ALSO hand-rolls a Loader2 spinner instead of Button's first-class `loading` prop.
defects.reproduction: `node scratchpad/probe.mjs` step A against http://localhost:9000/#/palettes; `npx vue-tsc -p tsconfig.demo.json --noEmit`; `npx eslint demo/palettes/browser/slug/PaletteSlugBar.vue`.
defects.proposedCure: `emphasis="quiet"` (ghost's successor rung) and `loading` instead of the hand-rolled spinner. If a true 'ghost' rung is wanted it belongs in glass-ui's ButtonEmphasis union, never as a demo override (edict 4). Repo-wide: sweep the 20 residue sites in the same pass, since one migration commit already touched this file without catching them.

defects.defect: Zero tests on either slug surface, and the e2e auth fixture seeds localStorage to bypass the login form entirely — so both BLOCKERs survived every gate in the repo. Five named mutations keep vitest, playwright, vue-tsc and eslint green.
defects.evidence: `grep -rn "PaletteSlugBar" test/ e2e/` → no output. `grep -rn "slug" test/` → no output. `grep -rn "enter slug\|slug or token\|Switch to slug\|Login" e2e/` → no output (no spec drives either login UI). e2e/smoke/fixtures/user-auth.ts:26-34 seeds `palette-user-slug`/`palette-user-token` via addInitScript before the first script runs. `npx vue-tsc -p tsconfig.demo.json --noEmit; echo EXIT=$?` → `EXIT=0`; `npx eslint demo/palettes/browser/slug/PaletteSlugBar.vue; echo ESLINT_EXIT=$?` → `ESLINT_EXIT=0`.
defects.mechanism: The only gate that can see this file is the typed reference at useSlugMigration.ts:84 — and what it guards is a permanent no-op (C-1). Behaviour is entirely outside the tested surface.
defects.reproduction: Green-keeping mutations, each shipping a broken product: (1) replace the whole <template> with <div/>; (2) invert line 205 to `const isAdmin = looksLikeSlug(normalized)` — every VALID slug becomes an admin token and wipes the session; (3) change looksLikeSlug's regex to /^$/ — everything becomes an admin token; (4) delete the `emit("switchSlug", …)` at line 213 — login becomes a no-op; (5) delete `@submit.prevent` from line 13 — zero behaviour change, because it was never bound (C-2).
defects.proposedCure: Delete the component (C-1) and give the SURVIVING surface three tests that would have failed on day one: (a) a submit on the real form emits switchSlug exactly once; (b) focus lands in the field after the transition settles; (c) a rejected login renders AND announces its message. Add one e2e that drives the form so the fixture's identity shape and the component's validator are forced to agree (C-24).

defects.defect: The entire slug credential protocol — looksLikeSlug, normalizeTokenInput, the submit routine, onCopySlug — is duplicated in SlugEditLayer.vue, and the two copies have already drifted.
defects.evidence: looksLikeSlug: PaletteSlugBar.vue:184-186 vs SlugEditLayer.vue:25-27 (identical regex). normalizeTokenInput: :188-196 vs :29-37 (identical). Submit routine: :198-225 `onSlugSwitch` vs :39-66 `onSlugSubmit`. onCopySlug: :168-170 vs :68-70. Drift: "Already signed in as this slug." vs "Already signed in."; error copy rendered-but-unreachable here vs NEVER RENDERED there (grep SlugEditLayer's template for slugError → 0 hits); focus broken here (C-3) vs working there (useTemplateRef, no out-in); Escape bound to the input by accident here (C-2) vs by design there. Both copies carry C-4, C-5 and C-16; C-5 is LIVE in the twin (reproduced).
defects.mechanism: Credential-parsing POLICY living in the view layer, so a second view needed a second copy. Fixing one leaves the other broken — already demonstrated by the two different strings for one condition.
defects.reproduction: Side-by-side read of the two files at the cited line ranges; the C-5 live repro exercises the twin's copy.
defects.proposedCure: Lift looksLikeSlug / normalizeTokenInput / classify-and-switch into a focused `slugCredential.ts` beside useSlugMigration.ts — a new FOCUSED module, not an addition to a god module (edict 1) and not a new shared/ dir (edict 3). The port then exposes one `submitCredential(raw): Promise<Result>`; the views render a field, a spinner and a message. One policy, one owner, one test.

defects.defect: The account-menu trigger is a 22 × 22 px tap target — below the WCAG 2.2 §2.5.8 minimum of 24 — and per C-8 it is the ONLY tabbable control in the logged-in bar.
defects.evidence: PaletteSlugBar.vue:84 `class="p-1 rounded-sm …"` around a `w-3.5 h-3.5` icon at :85. Measured against the live cascade: `"threeDot": { "w": 22, "h": 22 }` (also `"pill": 270.31×28.94`, `"login": 96.47×32.94`, `"menuItem": 121.02×34.94`). Live census on #/palettes shows the twin's three controls at identical geometry: `B · small tap targets (<24px): 6 [{"w":22,"h":22,"name":"Switch to slug"},{"w":22,"h":22,"name":"Generate new slug"},{"w":22,"h":22,"name":"Cancel"}, …]`. REPORT.md `smallTapTargets` for safari-desktop-light /#/palettes = 8, three of which are the slug cluster.
defects.mechanism: Per-instance sizing (`p-1`) instead of a design-system control-height token — edict 5. The component's own contribution to the REPORT's tap-target column is currently 0 only because of C-1.
defects.reproduction: `node scratchpad/probe2.mjs` — inject the exact markup from lines 84-86 into the live page inside `.app-layout` and read getBoundingClientRect.
defects.proposedCure: Adopt `DockControl compact` (the dock cluster's own primitive) or lift the control-height rule to the glass-ui root (edict 5) rather than a per-instance `p-1`.

defects.defect: The 50 ms `setTimeout` in onStartSlugEdit is never cancelled — no onBeforeUnmount / onScopeDispose — so unmounting within 50 ms leaves the callback to mutate a disposed component's refs and queue a nextTick against a dead instance. Two rapid activations schedule two uncoalesced timers.
defects.evidence: PaletteSlugBar.vue:176-181 `setTimeout(() => { slugEditMode.value = true; nextTick(() => { searchBarRef.value?.inputRef?.focus(); }); }, 50);` — the file contains no onBeforeUnmount, no onScopeDispose, no stored timer id (grep). Both menu items at :92 and :99 call onStartSlugEdit, as does the Login button at :74.
defects.mechanism: An untracked side effect scheduled outside the component's effect scope. The delay itself exists only to paper over the Popover close animation, and it is what desynchronises the focus call (C-3).
defects.reproduction: Structural — no clear path exists in the file. A route change or dialog close within 50 ms of activation exhibits it.
defects.proposedCure: Delete the timer (C-3's cure removes the need for it). If any deferral survives, it belongs in a scope-disposed `useTimeoutFn` so cleanup is automatic.

defects.defect: Dead public surface: a REQUIRED prop that is never read, an emit that is never emitted, and 2 of 3 defineExpose members with zero consumers.
defects.evidence: `grep -n "hasSavedPalettes" demo/palettes/browser/slug/PaletteSlugBar.vue` → only :147 and :150 (the declaration); compiled output confirms `hasSavedPalettes: { type: Boolean, required: true }`. `grep -n 'emit("copy")\|\$emit(.copy' …` → no output, yet `copy: []` is declared at :155. `grep -rn "resetEditMode" demo/` → only its own definition (:231) and the defineExpose (:236). `slugEditMode` is likewise exposed and unconsumed; only `setError` is referenced, and that reference is C-1's permanent no-op. Both gates pass: `vue-tsc EXIT=0`, `eslint ESLINT_EXIT=0`.
defects.mechanism: API that outlived its consumer — the decision `hasSavedPalettes` once fed now lives at useSlugMigration.ts:59 (`deps.savedPalettes.value.length > 0`). Exposing the raw `slugEditMode` ref additionally hands external code a writable internal flag (encapsulation leak; its exposed TYPE is fine — see C-25b).
defects.reproduction: The greps above; the compiler output in C-25a is the receipt for `required: true`.
defects.proposedCure: Delete all three — they die with the component under C-1's cure. If the component were kept, `copy` should be emitted with the result of an awaited writeClipboard (C-13), which is the only reading under which it earns its declaration.

defects.defect: `void writeClipboard(userSlug)` discards the discriminated `{ ok } | { ok, reason }` result the glass-ui primitive exists to return, so a denied clipboard write is visually indistinguishable from success — and success is silent too.
defects.evidence: PaletteSlugBar.vue:168-170 `function onCopySlug() { if (userSlug) void writeClipboard(userSlug); }`. Contract quoted from node_modules/@mkbabb/glass-ui/dist/composables/dom/useClipboard.d.ts: `/** A failed copy always names its channel; a successful copy carries no reason. */ export type CopyResult = { ok: true } | { ok: false; reason: CopyFailureReason };` and `/** Stateless one-shot clipboard write — the honest primitive … Returns the discriminated result … rather than a lossy boolean, for identical call ergonomics: const { ok } = await writeClipboard(text) */`. `CopyFailureReason = "clipboard-api" | "no-api"`.
defects.mechanism: `void` on a primitive whose entire design point is a nameable failure. The menu closes either way, so the user cannot tell.
defects.reproduction: Structural — the discard is unconditional. Exhibited on any non-secure context or denied permission (Safari private mode).
defects.proposedCure: `const { ok } = await writeClipboard(userSlug); emit("copy", ok)` — which finally gives the dead `copy` emit (C-12) a reason to exist and lets one owner render a single feedback affordance for all copy actions.

defects.defect: No cancel path clears `slugError`, and no `clearError` is exposed — so a stale error persists across modes indefinitely and the owner cannot clear it either.
defects.evidence:
PaletteSlugBar.vue:172-174 `onStartSlugEdit` clears both input and error; :231-234 `resetEditMode` clears input and mode but NOT error. Neither cancel path clears it: :14 `@keydown.escape.stop="slugEditMode = false"`, :36 `@click="slugEditMode = false"`. The error

at :124 renders OUTSIDE the , i.e. in BOTH modes. `defineExpose({ slugEditMode, setError, resetEditMode })` at :236 offers no clearError.
defects.mechanism: Asymmetric teardown — three exit paths, one of which clears state and two of which do not, against a message element that outlives the mode it belongs to.
defects.reproduction:
Structural — read from the three exit paths against the

's placement outside the Transition.
defects.proposedCure:
One `resetSlugState()` clearing input, error and mode together, called on every entry and every exit; and move the

inside the edit branch (see C-21) so it cannot outlive its field.

defects.defect: The error line is `absolute` + `whitespace-nowrap` while the message it renders is an unbounded server string, so it overflows its bar and can collide with whatever sits below it.
defects.evidence: PaletteSlugBar.vue:124 `class="absolute left-0 -bottom-4 text-mono-small text-destructive whitespace-nowrap"`. The `else` branch forwards the raw server message: useSlugMigration.ts:87 `slugBarRef.value?.setError((e instanceof Error ? e.message : "") || "Login failed")`. Pass-1 measurement: `errorP: { text: "Something went catastrophically wrong with your slug login a…", right: 600.6, hostRight: 440, overflowsHostPx: 160.6 }`.
defects.mechanism: A fixed-geometry slot for variable-length, externally-supplied content. The REPORT's horizontalOverflow list is empty only because the component never renders (C-1).
defects.reproduction: Pass-1 live measurement after forcing a long setError on the mounted SFC (run-1.md §C-15).
defects.proposedCure: Drop whitespace-nowrap, let it wrap, and reserve the space in flow rather than `absolute -bottom-4` (which also lets the message collide with the row below).

defects.defect: The catch block is unreachable, and it is a stale copy of a substring mapping this repo already diagnosed as broken and replaced in the composable.
defects.evidence: PaletteSlugBar.vue:216-221 maps `msg.includes("409")` / `"404"` / `"429"` on `e?.message`. Unreachable because nothing in the try can throw asynchronously — emit() is synchronous and the parent handler's rejection lands in the parent's microtask (C-4). Already disproved: useSlugMigration.ts:78-82 carries the S.W2 W2-6 comment — "branch on the typed `ApiProblem.status`, not `.message` substrings — the server titles ('Already logged in as this user', 'User not found', 'Rate limit exceeded') never contain '409'/'404'/'429', so those branches matched nothing and the authored copy below never showed." The corrected version lives there; the disproved version was left standing here AND in SlugEditLayer.vue:59-62. `e: any` at :216 is the file's only untyped catch parameter.
defects.mechanism: A legacy dual path (edict 2): the cure was applied at one site and the defective original was never swept from the two others.
defects.reproduction: Read the comment at useSlugMigration.ts:78-82 against lines 216-221; pass-1's 5 live invocations showed slugError only ever set by the explicit line-208 assignment.
defects.proposedCure: Delete the block. C-4's `await` gives the one honest error path, typed on `ApiProblem.status`, and it should live in the shared `slugCredential.ts` of C-19 so there is a single copy to be right.

defects.defect: `normalizeTokenInput` is a masking fallback that silently launders shell/.env fragments into credentials, and it is structurally why C-5's catch-all was never narrowed. It is also called twice per submit.
defects.evidence: PaletteSlugBar.vue:188-196 — `token.match(/^ADMIN_TOKEN\s*=\s*(.+)$/i)` then quote-stripping. Called at :204 (`normalizeTokenInput(raw).toLowerCase()`) and again at :213 (`isAdmin ? normalizeTokenInput(raw) : normalized`). Duplicated verbatim at SlugEditLayer.vue:29-37.
defects.mechanism: Edict 2 forbids masking fallbacks. The `ADMIN_TOKEN=` prefix is the ONE signal that could have made the admin route explicit; instead of being the TRIGGER it is merely tolerated, leaving the negated shape test (C-5) to do the classifying.
defects.reproduction: Pass-1 emission capture: `'ADMIN_TOKEN="sekrit"' → ["switchSlug", "sekrit", true]`.
defects.proposedCure: Invert it: make `ADMIN_TOKEN=` (or a distinct affordance) the ONLY admin path, call it once, and reject everything that is neither a slug nor an explicit admin credential.

defects.defect: The pill's hover-vs-click routing is decided once, non-reactively, at setup: glass-ui reads `matchMedia("(pointer: coarse)").matches` into a plain `let` with no change listener, so a device whose pointer class changes keeps the wrong popover root for the component's lifetime.
defects.evidence: node_modules/@mkbabb/glass-ui/dist/popover-BQGYXZyO.js: `let _ = typeof window < "u" && typeof window.matchMedia == "function" && window.matchMedia("(pointer: coarse)").matches, v = i(() => n.trigger === "hover" && !_); E({ usesHoverRoot: v });` — `_` is a plain `let`, read once; the computed's only non-constant input is the prop, so it can never re-evaluate. Consumed by PaletteSlugBar.vue:45 `<Popover v-if="userSlug" trigger="hover" :close-delay="0" :open-delay="300">`.
defects.mechanism: A media query sampled instead of observed. A tablet that gains a keyboard/trackpad mid-session, or a window dragged to a touch display, keeps HoverCardRoot with its excludeTouch handlers (C-8) and the tooltip becomes unreachable by every input the device has. This is a PRODUCER defect surfaced by this component's trigger choice — per the standing BH/BI relay edict it belongs in the glass-ui inbox, not a demo patch.
defects.reproduction: NONE — read from vendor source. The runtime consequence on a pointer-class change is labelled a HYPOTHESIS; the non-reactivity itself is source-proven.
defects.proposedCure: Consumer side: C-8's cure — a focusable trigger makes the routing question moot, because focus works on both pointer classes. Producer side (relay): bind the query with `matchMedia(...).addEventListener("change", …)` so `usesHoverRoot` is genuinely reactive.

defects.defect: The design system is reached through pass-through rename shims and the root barrel instead of glass-ui's published subpaths.
defects.evidence: demo/ui/button/index.ts is one line: `export { Button } from "@mkbabb/glass-ui";`. demo/ui/popover/index.ts is one line: `export { Popover, PopoverTrigger, PopoverContent } from "@mkbabb/glass-ui";`. PaletteSlugBar.vue:133-134 imports from those two shims; :145 imports writeClipboard from the root barrel rather than `@mkbabb/glass-ui/dom`. SlugEditLayer.vue:4 already imports `@mkbabb/glass-ui/dock` directly.
defects.mechanism: shadcn-era aliases that survived the migration — edict 2 (no aliases / dual paths) and edict 4 (glass-ui is the design system, not demo/ui/).
defects.reproduction: cat the two index.ts files.
defects.proposedCure: Import the published subpaths directly and retire demo/ui/button and demo/ui/popover.

defects.defect: The repo's own e2e test identity would be classified as an admin token by this component: FAKE_SLUG = "test-user" is two words, which looksLikeSlug rejects.
defects.evidence: e2e/smoke/fixtures/user-auth.ts:30 `const FAKE_SLUG = "test-user";` vs PaletteSlugBar.vue:185 `/^[a-z]+-[a-z]+-[a-z]+-[a-z]+$/` and the server's real 4-word shape at api/src/modules/session/slugWords.ts:84-90. The mismatch never surfaces because the fixture seeds localStorage via addInitScript (lines 26-34) and bypasses the login UI entirely.
defects.mechanism: The fixture's identity shape and the component's validator drifted apart with no gate able to notice — the same bypass that makes C-18's gates vacuous.
defects.reproduction: `grep -n FAKE_SLUG e2e/smoke/fixtures/user-auth.ts` against the regex at line 185; `node -e` on the predicate returns false for "test-user" ⇒ isAdmin true.
defects.proposedCure: Make the fixture's slug the real server shape (four words) and add the one e2e that drives the form, so the two definitions are forced to agree.

defects.defect: Two pass-2 hypotheses were formed and KILLED by measurement; recorded as negatives so the ledger shows what was hunted and not found.
defects.evidence: (a) Prop-shadowing at line 205 does NOT mis-compile. `node -e "…compileScript(descriptor,{id:'x', propsDestructure:true})…"` → `78: const isAdmin = !looksLikeSlug(normalized);` stays a LOCAL, while genuine prop reads are rewritten: `42: if (__props.userSlug) void writeClipboard(__props.userSlug);` and `80: if (looksLikeSlug(normalized) && normalized === __props.userSlug) {`. Readability hazard only. (b) `defineExpose({ slugEditMode })` IS ref-unwrapped in the public instance type. Scratch program extending tsconfig.demo.json with `const probe = r.value!.slugEditMode.value;` → `npx vue-tsc -p scratchpad/tsconfig.probe.json --noEmit` → `expose-probe.ts(9,37): error TS2551: Property 'value' does not exist on type 'boolean'. Did you mean 'valueOf'?` — so no type/runtime mismatch exists.
defects.mechanism: N/A — these are negative results. What survives from (b) is only the encapsulation point already folded into C-12: the exposed property is writable, so external code could flip the component's internal edit mode. No consumer does.
defects.reproduction: The two commands above, both re-runnable.
defects.proposedCure: None required. Keep the negatives on the record so a later pass does not re-litigate them.

result.axis: CHALLENGE-D — design (visual truth, state coverage, motion, design-system boundary, proportion/seat law) for demo/palettes/browser/search/SearchFilterBar.vue
result.modelObserved: Opus 5 — exact model id `claude-opus-5[1m]` (1M-context arm). Seat declared at spawn, not inherited.
result.strongestDefect: D2-B1 — the entire Tags filter section is inert. `SearchFilterBar.vue:51-55` calls `:checked` / `@update:checked` against glass-ui 7's `Checkbox`, whose only contract is `modelValue` / `update:modelValue`. Both fall through silently, so `toggleTag()` is never called and `update:selectedTags` is never emitted; the producer falls back to its own uncontrolled cell, so the box PAINTS checked while the wall never filters, the badge never counts, and the state dies when the popover is re-created. Measured cross-engine: after ticking pastel/neon/earthy the boxes read `aria-checked="true"` with `badge: null` and `cards: 2` unchanged; after Escape+reopen all three read `aria-checked="false"`. The DOM carries `checked="false"` as a raw fallthrough attribute — the proof that it is not a prop.
result.negativeProof: Verdict is DEFECTIVE, so this field records the claims I tested and could NOT substantiate — the negatives I owe, so no downstream seat re-litigates them. (1) "Controls in the popover are unreachable by Tab" — FALSE. WebKit suggested it; Chromium (`probe6.mjs`, per the repo's own standing rule at `audit/visual/states.mjs:6-9` that macOS ships Full Keyboard Access OFF) shows all six control species reachable in DOM order. Claim withdrawn. (2) "Motion is ad hoc / ignores prefers-reduced-motion" — FALSE. `.filter-option` uses `var(--duration-fast) var(--ease-standard)` (:246); bare `transition-*` utilities inherit house tokens via `demo/styles/foundation.css:128-129`; `demo/styles/animations.css:184-192` is a global reduce guard with a deliberate overlay-opacity carve-out at :202-210; no layout-forcing property is animated. (3) "RTL is broken" — FALSE; `shots/rtl-desktop/browse.png` mirrors the trigger to the pill's logical start correctly. (4) "Horizontal overflow" — FALSE; `audit/visual/REPORT.json` `/#/browse` `overflowX: 0` in all four matrices, confirmed at 390/720/1440. (5) "Undersized touch targets" — FALSE; `[role=radio]` measures 44x44 around an 18x18 visible mark, which is exactly PROPORTION-AUDIT §5.7 / PR-12. (6) `verbatimModuleSyntax` — CLEAN (:144 `import type { Tag }`, all other imports value-position). (7) Vue 3.5 idioms — CLEAN (:147 reactive props destructure; no template refs and no `defineModel` round-trip exist, so `useTemplateRef`/`shallowRef` are not applicable). (8) "Escape inside the nested MiniColorPicker mismanages focus" — FALSE; openDialogs 2->1, outer stays expanded, focus returns to the exact connected opener, which is VISUAL-CONSTITUTION §5.1's rule. (9) The forced-colors matrix is INCONCLUSIVE because WebKit does not truly emulate it, so no forced-colors finding is claimed.

defects.defect: The entire Tags filter section is inert: ticking a tag paints a checked box and changes nothing — no filtering, no badge, and the state dies when the popover is re-created.
defects.evidence: demo/palettes/browser/search/SearchFilterBar.vue:51-55 passes `:checked` and `@update:checked`. node_modules/@mkbabb/glass-ui/dist/components/checkbox/Checkbox.vue.d.ts declares `modelValue?: CheckedState|null` and emits only `update:modelValue` — neither `checked` nor `update:checked` exists. Live DOM (probe4.mjs, Chromium+WebKit): checkbox attributes = [data-slot="checkbox", class="checkbox …", checked="false", role="checkbox", aria-checked="false", data-state="unchecked"] — `checked` present as a raw fallthrough attribute, which only happens for undeclared props. After ticking pastel/neon/earthy one tick apart: ariaChecked true/true/true, badge=null, cards=2 (unchanged). probe3.mjs: selectedTagsAfterSequential=["pastel","neon","earthy"] while the badge reads "1" (the tier alone).
defects.mechanism: Retired shadcn/radix-era component API called against a glass-ui 7 contract. Vue fallthrough attributes fail silently: the undeclared prop lands as a DOM attribute and the undeclared emit lands in $attrs and never fires, so `toggleTag()` is never called and `update:selectedTags` is never emitted. With `modelValue` absent the producer runs uncontrolled, so the box paints checked — the surface asserts a state the product does not hold.
defects.reproduction: node docs/tranches/V/megatranche/audit/components/SearchFilterBar/probe4.mjs with PROBE_ORIGIN pointed at a dev server started as `VITE_API_URL=/api npx vite --port 9100` (a relative base keeps detectDevMisconfig() false so the availability latch never trips and /colors/tags can be stubbed). Manually: open /#/browse with a populated tag catalogue, open the ⋮ menu, tick three tags — the wall does not change and no badge appears; press Escape and reopen — all three are unchecked again.
defects.proposedCure: Transpose onto glass-ui `DropdownMenuCheckboxItem` with `v-model` bound to one owned `selectedTags` model. The producer already owns the whole controlled-checkbox mechanism; the local `toggleTag` array-splice helper disappears with it.

defects.defect: The tallest legal state of the popover is 685.6px with no max-height and no scroll container anywhere in its ancestor chain; the only clear-filters control renders 101px below the fold at 1440x900, and on mobile / 200% zoom the menu is taller than the viewport and is pushed off the top of the screen.
defects.evidence: probe2.mjs, tallest legal state (4 sections + Clear-all row). Desktop 1440x900: content rect {x:433,y:381,w:240,h:685.6}, contentOverflowBottom +166.6; clearRow {y:1001.3,h:36} visibleInViewport:false; colorInput y=944.3. Mobile 390x664: content {x:104,y:-315.3,w:240,h:691.7}. Zoom-200 720x450: content {x:337.5,y:-390,w:240,h:663.9}. Measured scroll chain: div.popover-content overflowY:visible maxHeight:none h685.6 -> popper wrapper overflowY:visible maxHeight:none -> body.relative overflowY:visible. The only overflow-y:auto in the component is on the tag list (SearchFilterBar.vue:49 `max-h-28 overflow-y-auto`). Frames: shots/tall-desktop-light-open.png, shots/tall-mobile-open.png, shots/tall-zoom200-open.png.
defects.mechanism: An overlay whose height is data-dependent (tags list) and state-dependent (the v-if Clear-all row at :110) was designed with no containment strategy. Containment was applied to the one region that needed it least. The escalation is structural: `Clear all filters` is v-if-gated on activeFilterCount>0 and appended at the bottom, so the only escape hatch materialises exactly in the state where the menu is tallest and it cannot be reached.
defects.reproduction: node .../probe2.mjs (PROBE_ORIGIN=http://localhost:9100). Manually: /#/browse with tags loaded, open ⋮, set the Featured tier — at 1440x900 the Find-by-Color section and the Clear-all row are below the viewport and nothing scrolls; at 390x664 the Sort and Tier sections are above the top of the screen and the menu paints over the Dock.
defects.proposedCure: Transposing onto glass-ui `DropdownMenuContent` inherits the producer's collision/max-height/scroll behaviour and removes the local `max-h-28` scroller. Separately, split the drawer: sort is not a filter (activeFilterCount excludes it), and surfacing applied filters as removable chips beneath the SearchBar removes the need for a bottom-anchored Clear-all entirely.

defects.defect: The active-filter count badge is clipped to an illegible olive crescent by the trigger's own `contain: paint` plus its 9999px radius; the digit never renders. It is also absent from the trigger's accessible name. This overturns pass 1's recorded negative ("the badge is not clipped by any ancestor").
defects.evidence: probe7.mjs, WebKit and Chromium, byte-identical: trigger.contain="paint", trigger.borderRadius="9999px", trigger::before.zIndex="1", badge.zIndex="auto", badge overhang 4.1px top and 4.1px right (SearchFilterBar.vue:7-12 `absolute -right-1 -top-1`), badgeText="1". Five-point hit test: centre->span (badge), topEdge->div.px-4.sm:px-6 (the pane body BEHIND the trigger), rightEdge->div.input-bar.search-seated (the SearchBar pill behind it), topRightCorner->div.px-4.sm:px-6, bottomLeft->span. badgePointsThatHitTheBadge = 2 of 5 in BOTH engines. Frames at 3x DPR: shots/probe5-badge-3x.png, shots/probe7-webkit-badge-3x.png, shots/probe7-chromium-badge-3x.png. probe4.mjs: triggerName="Filters", triggerText="1", badgeAnnouncedInName=false.
defects.mechanism: A per-instance overhanging badge was hand-positioned inside a producer root that declares paint containment. `contain: paint` clips descendants to the padding box and the pill radius bevels the remainder. Two independent occlusions: the containment box, and the trigger's ::before capsule fill at z-index 1 painting over a z-auto child. The aria-label on the trigger then overrides its own text content, so the count is not announced either — the state is color-and-glyph-only, which VISUAL-CONSTITUTION §4.1 forbids.
defects.reproduction: node .../probe7.mjs. Manually: /#/browse, open ⋮, choose the Featured tier, press Escape, and look at the trigger at any zoom — an olive sliver, no digit.
defects.proposedCure: Use the glass-ui `Badge` atom (dist/components/badge/index.d.ts, variant/tone/size/surface axes) as a sibling of the trigger outside the contain:paint root, and put the count in the trigger's accessible name (aria-label="Filters, 2 active"). Never hand-position an overhang inside a producer root.

defects.defect: The field labelled `aria-label="Search by CSS color"` with placeholder `#hex, hsl(...)` accepts exactly one CSS colour syntax and silently searches a DIFFERENT colour — the swatch's `#4488cc` — for every other input, with no error state anywhere. A valid accepted input and an invalid input produce identical visible outcomes.
defects.evidence: SearchFilterBar.vue:218: `const hex = text.startsWith("#") && /^#[0-9a-f]{6}$/i.test(text) ? text : pickerHex.value;`. probe3.mjs typed six inputs and clicked Search each time; every row returned errorShown:false, rejections:[], swatchBefore===swatchAfter===rgb(68,136,204) and swatchLabel unchanged at "Open color picker, current color #4488cc": `hsl(200 50% 50%)` (the placeholder's own example), `#abc`, `rebeccapurple`, `oklch(70% 0.15 200)`, `garbage!!` all fell back to #4488cc; `#AABBCC` was accepted and searched but the swatch still showed #4488cc. `parseColorIn` — value.js's own CSS colour parser, which parses every one of those — is already imported at :145 and used at :206.
defects.mechanism: A regex gate placed in front of the product's own competence, failing closed to a substitution rather than open to the parser. Because there is no error state and no representation of the applied colour, the substitution is undetectable from the UI.
defects.reproduction: node .../probe3.mjs. Manually: /#/browse, open ⋮, type `hsl(200 50% 50%)` into the Find-by-Color field, click Search — the badge increments and the wall filters, on #4488cc, with no indication.
defects.proposedCure: Delete the regex gate at :218. Pass the raw trimmed text to `parseColorIn` inside a try/catch and render the two real states: parsed -> the swatch and a removable applied-filter chip both take that colour; unparsed -> a named error on the field. This also makes the currently-unreachable `searching` register meaningful or honestly deletable.

defects.defect: Five consumer-authored API calls in this one file are silently inert against glass-ui 7 (`variant="ghost"` twice, `:checked`, `@update:checked`, `p-0`) and a sixth is half-inert (`h-8 w-8` renders 32x40).
defects.evidence: glass-ui 7 ButtonProps (dist/components/button/Button.vue.d.ts) declares emphasis/tone/size/iconOnly/loading — there is NO `variant`. Live DOM of the trigger (Chromium): `data-emphasis="secondary" data-tone="neutral" data-size="md" data-icon-only="true" … variant="ghost" aria-label="Filters"`, rect 32x40. PopoverContent authored `class="w-60 p-0"` (:16) computes `padding: 20.352px 16px` because the producer emits px-(--overlay-pad-inline)/py-(--overlay-pad-block).
