Violates VISUAL-CONSTITUTION.md §4 (palette identity = --type-subheading) and PROPORTION-AUDIT.md §5 laws 2 and 8.
defects.reproduction: Dev server up; `node docs/tranches/V/megatranche/audit/components/PaletteCardMenu/probe-D9-pass2.mjs` — seeds one saved palette into localStorage["color-palettes"] as {version:1,palettes:[...]}, loads /#/palettes at 390x844, measures the metadata row.
defects.proposedCure: Architectural transposition, not a flex tweak: VISUAL-CONSTITUTION.md:102 already deletes the card action menu — 'the card body owns no expand, inline rename, action menu, transient result or hover-only swatch-action path... rename/lifecycle/export actions and durable operation state live in the selected inspector.' Delete PaletteCardMenu.vue, move its 17 actions to the selected inspector, and reduce the card to the single named <button type="button" aria-pressed> seat of PROPORTION-AUDIT.md §5 law 12. The row then carries identity plus the seat and nothing competes with it.

defects.defect: On /#/mix the entire PaletteCard — this menu's trigger included — is nested inside a <button aria-pressed>. Invalid HTML content model plus an ARIA presentational-children hazard that permits the trigger to be pruned from the accessibility tree.
defects.evidence: demo/workbenches/mix/MixSourceSelector.vue:238-268 wraps <PaletteCard> in <button :aria-pressed :aria-label="`… palette ${palette.name}`" @click="togglePalette(palette)">. Measured live: probe-D6-pass2-results.json "mix": {"nestedInteractiveInButton":2,"nestedSample":[{"tag":"BUTTON","label":"Palette menu","outerLabel":"Select palette Muted Terracotta and Deep Sea Foam Study"},{..."Select palette Temp"}],"paletteCardsInsideButton":2}. Screenshot: evidence/pass2-mix-source.png.
defects.mechanism: button's content model is phrasing content with NO interactive-content descendant; role=button is a role whose descendants are presentational, so a UA may remove the whole subtree from the a11y tree. Mix wrapped the card in the selection button instead of putting the button inside the card, and this component's trigger is the interactive content that makes it illegal rather than merely untidy. The same call site passes zero listeners, so all 17 emits are inert there.
defects.reproduction: Dev server up; `node docs/.../probe-D6-pass2.mjs` (its mixNesting arm navigates to /#/mix, selects the Palettes source mode, and counts `button button` matches). Static confirmation: MixSourceSelector.vue:238-268.
defects.proposedCure: PROPORTION-AUDIT.md §5 law 12 already specifies the shape: the Card/article root is a noninteractive container whose one native named <button type="button" aria-pressed> child spans the specimen/identity region. Invert the nesting — the selection seat goes inside the card, not around it. Under P2-1's transposition the menu leaves the card entirely and the illegality dissolves with it.

defects.defect: The degraded-state annotation ('offline') renders at 1.75:1 contrast — the text that explains WHY an action is unavailable is the least legible element in the panel, 45% dimmer than the disabled label it explains.
defects.evidence: Rendered-pixel sampling (probe-D8-pass2.mjs: screenshot -> -> canvas -> getImageData), light, composited menu surface rgb(235,224,217): annotation ink rgb(176,171,168) = 1.75:1; Rename ink rgb(28,25,23) = 13.49:1; Delete ink rgb(28,24,22) = 13.59:1; header ink rgb(112,89,66) = 5.07:1. Mechanism measured in probe-D7-pass2-results.json: {"--opacity-disabled":"0.5"} and {"itemOpacityDisabled":"0.5","annotationOpacity":"0.55","effectiveAlpha":0.275}. Visual witness: evidence/pass2-light-degraded.png ('⊘ Publish OFFLINE').
defects.mechanism: Nested opacity multiplication. glass-ui dims the whole disabled row — `.dropdown-menu__item[data-disabled]{opacity:var(--opacity-disabled)}` in dist/glass-ui.css — and the consumer's `opacity-55` (PaletteCardMenu.vue:37 and :57) then multiplies inside it: 0.5 x 0.55 = 0.275. Inverts the K-INV5 register's stated purpose (the file's own comment at :24-26) and breaches VISUAL-CONSTITUTION.md §4.1 ('state/value and associated error/status are explicit').
defects.reproduction: Dev server up; `node docs/.../probe-D8-pass2.mjs` — opens the menu on /#/palettes, sets data-disabled on the live Publish row and appends the exact annotation span the SFC writes, screenshots, and samples pixels.
defects.proposedCure: An availability reason is not a shortcut annotation and must not live inside the element it is dimming. Remove the consumer opacity entirely (the row's own --opacity-disabled is the only dimming the design gets to spend) and move the reason out of the dimmed row — or, per P2-1's transposition, into the inspector's durable operation state where it renders at full ink.

defects.defect: At two of the four PaletteCard call sites the menu's emits reach no listener: the whole Export submenu is dead on /#/extract, and every one of the 17 actions is dead on /#/mix.
defects.evidence: The Export submenu has no v-if (PaletteCardMenu.vue:107-130) so it renders for every paletteKind at every call site. Call sites: demo/palettes/PalettesPane.vue:82-97 (export wired), demo/palettes/BrowsePane.vue:92-119 (all 16 wired), demo/workbenches/extract/ExtractWorkbench.vue:145-156 (click/save/rename/add-color only — NO @export), demo/workbenches/mix/MixSourceSelector.vue:264-267 (NO listeners at all). Extract's palette id is `__extracted__…` -> getPaletteKind returns 'temporary' (demo/palettes/utils.ts:20-30), so its menu renders Save · Rename · Export▸(5 rows) — 5 of 8 rows inert. Measured: probe-D6-pass2-results.json "extract": {"paletteMenus":2,"downloads":[]}.
defects.mechanism: The stringly-typed command bus (`action: [action: string]` at :225, received into a Record<string,()=>void> at PaletteCard.vue:293-313 that silently drops unknown keys) means neither the compiler nor the runtime can notice that a whole submenu is being rendered at a site that never subscribed to it. Breaches PROPORTION-AUDIT.md §5 law 5 — a labelled action that emits into the void is neither data, status, a named action, a drag affordance nor removed.
defects.reproduction: Static: read the four call sites above. Live: `node docs/.../probe-D6-pass2.mjs` extract arm (navigates /#/extract, counts palette menus, records zero downloads).
defects.proposedCure: Type the bus as a union of the 17 literals so an unsubscribed emit is a compile error — one line. Structurally, the actions that survive belong in the inspector (P2-1's transposition), where each call site opts into the surface it can actually serve rather than inheriting a 17-row menu by rendering a card.

defects.defect: The 32px icon gutter the parent panel establishes is abandoned in the Export submenu (8px), a 24px rhythm break between two panels of one menu, alongside an italic/upright voice split.
defects.evidence: probe-D7-pass2-results.json submenu.items — parent (Publish/Rename/Export/Delete): hasIcon true, itemLeft 1017, textLeft 1049, textInset 32, fontStyle normal. Sub (JSON/CSS Custom Properties/Tailwind Config/SVG Swatch/PNG Swatch): hasIcon false, itemLeft 1202, textLeft 1210, textInset 8, fontStyle italic. Visual: evidence/pass2-desktop-submenu.png and evidence/mobile-light-submenu-open.png.
defects.mechanism: The five export rows are the same species as the eleven parent rows but were authored without leading glyphs, so text starts at the bare 8px item padding instead of after the 8px pad + 16px glyph + 8px gap the parent set. Nothing about an export format earns a different left edge. PROPORTION-AUDIT.md §5 law 8 (rendered relation over token intent) and law 2 (one anatomy per repeated species).
defects.reproduction: Dev server up; `node docs/.../probe-D7-pass2.mjs` — opens the menu, hovers the Export sub-trigger, measures text-node x for every menuitem in both panels via Range.getBoundingClientRect.
defects.proposedCure: One anatomy for one species: either every menuitem in the tree carries a glyph in the same gutter, or none does. Under P2-1's transposition the export seat becomes a two-activation Prepare/Download control in the inspector (PALETTE-CONTRACT.md:325) and the sub-panel disappears rather than being re-styled.

defects.defect: The divider budget is inverted: three separators are spent in this menu tree — one of them inside the submenu, separating text export formats from image export formats — and zero separate the irreversible Delete from the harmless Export disclosure 44px above it.
defects.evidence: probe-D6-pass2-results.json parentOrder: label y618, separator y654.1, Publish y659.1, Rename y703.1, separator y751.1, Export(sub-trigger) y756.1, Delete y800.1 — Delete in the SAME group as Export, no separator. probe-D7-pass2-results.json submenu.separators includes {"panel":"sub","y":898} (between Tailwind Config and SVG Swatch). Delete's ink is 1/255 from Rename's (probe-D8: rgb(28,24,22) vs rgb(28,25,23)).
defects.mechanism: PROPORTION-AUDIT.md §5 law 4 — 'a divider is retained only when grouping would be ambiguous without it.' The one genuinely ambiguous boundary in the component (irreversible destruction abutting a disclosure, in chromatically identical ink, with no confirmation step) is the one place a line was withheld, while a consequence-free file-type taxonomy got one.
defects.reproduction: Dev server up; `node docs/.../probe-D6-pass2.mjs` (parentOrder) and `node docs/.../probe-D7-pass2.mjs` (submenu.separators).
defects.proposedCure: Spend the boundary where the ambiguity is. Delete the submenu's format separator (spacing plus label already express that grouping) and give destruction its own group. Structurally: destruction is a confirmed, durable operation and belongs in the inspector's action region (PROPORTION-AUDIT.md PR-08), not one unseparated row below a disclosure in a transient overlay.

defects.defect: No DropdownMenuGroup anywhere in the tree; the 'Admin' label is an orphan text node with no role="group" and no aria-labelledby, so elevated-authority scope has no programmatic boundary.
defects.evidence: `cat demo/ui/dropdown-menu/index.ts` exports DropdownMenuGroup; `grep -rn "DropdownMenuGroup" demo --include="*.vue"` returns no matches. Measured DOM (probe-D6-pass2-results.json parentOrder) is flat: div.dropdown-menu__label, div[role=separator], div[role=menuitem] xN — no role="group", no aria-labelledby. Source: the Admin arm is DropdownMenuLabel at PaletteCardMenu.vue:155 followed by two bare DropdownMenuItems at :158 and :163.
defects.mechanism: The component declares three semantic groups by comment and by separator (lifecycle :15-102, disclosure+destruction :107-150, Admin :153-170) and expresses none structurally. An AT walk announces 'Admin' as a bare string then two menuitems that claim no scope; `Delete (admin)` and the owner's own `Delete` differ only by a parenthetical. Breaches VISUAL-CONSTITUTION.md §7: 'Elevated authority is communicated by labeling and scope, not by a fourth visual system.'
defects.reproduction: Dev server up; `node docs/.../probe-D6-pass2.mjs` — the parentOrder arm enumerates [role=menu]'s direct children and their roles.
defects.proposedCure: Reuse the primitive that is already exported, already re-exported through the barrel, and used zero times: wrap the admin arm in <DropdownMenuGroup aria-labelledby="…"> bound to the existing label. This is exactly the 'reuse existing component-type names' edict. Under P2-1's transposition, scope becomes a labelled region of the inspector instead.

defects.defect: With align="end" and the producer's default offset, the open menu occludes 41.6% of the ADJACENT palette card — a different bounded entity than the one it belongs to.
defects.evidence: probe-D6-pass2-results.json occlusion: menu {x:1010,y:611,w:192,h:240.1}; cards [{"Palette: Muted Terracotta…",x:754,y:518.6,w:462,h:100},{"Palette: Temp",x:754,y:630.6,w:462,h:100}]; overlapPx [{"…Terracotta…",area:1459,cardArea:46200},{"Palette: Temp",area:19200,cardArea:46200}] -> 19200/46200 = 41.6%. Same mechanism at 390px produces legible double text (pass-1 evidence/mobile-light-submenu-open.png).
defects.mechanism: PaletteCardMenu.vue:7 sets align="end" and takes the producer default side/offset, so the panel drops straight down the list onto the next entity. VISUAL-CONSTITUTION.md §2 ('one surface has one tier') and PROPORTION-AUDIT.md §5 law 1 ('a Card houses one bounded object/specimen') both fail: a translucent overlay owned by entity A renders over 41.6% of entity B at a translucency that lets B's ink read through.
defects.reproduction: Dev server up; `node docs/.../probe-D6-pass2.mjs` — the occlusion arm intersects the [role=menu] rect with every [role=article] rect on /#/palettes at 1440x1000 with two seeded palettes.
defects.proposedCure: A per-entity transient overlay in a vertical list of entities cannot be geometrically fixed by a side/collisionPadding choice — every placement lands on a neighbour. The canon's answer is the selected inspector: a persistent region outside the field, which is where VISUAL-CONSTITUTION.md:102 sends these actions.

defects.defect: The five leading glyphs the SFC writes are not aria-hidden and remain in the accessibility tree as unnamed decorative duplicates — while the producer's own chevron IS hidden and the sibling file 15 lines away gets it right.
defects.evidence: probe-D6-pass2-results.json iconsAria: [{"parentText":"Publish","ariaHidden":null},{"Rename",null},{"Export",null},{"Export","true"} <- producer ChevronRight,{"Delete",null}]. Source: bare <svg> at PaletteCardMenu.vue:20,:54,:68,:78,:88,:98,:109,:138,:159,:160,:167 with no aria-hidden/role/title. Correct idiom in the same folder: PaletteCard.vue:103 `<MoreHorizontal class="w-4 h-4 text-muted-foreground" aria-hidden="true" />`.
defects.mechanism: @lucide/vue renders a plain <svg> with no ARIA defaults; the consumer must hide decorative instances. PROPORTION-AUDIT.md §5 law 5 offers exactly six dispositions for a small mark (data, status, labelled action, drag affordance, focus/selection register, removed) — a decorative duplicate that is also not hidden is the one disposition the law does not offer.
defects.reproduction: Dev server up; `node docs/.../probe-D6-pass2.mjs` — the iconsAria arm reads aria-hidden off every [role=menuitem] svg.
defects.proposedCure: aria-hidden="true" on every decorative glyph, matching the sibling PaletteCard.vue:103. Better at the root: glass-ui's DropdownMenuItem should own an icon slot that hides its own content, so no consumer has to remember (relay to the glass-ui BH inbox per the standing fond).

defects.defect: The menu header truncates the palette name to 56% and offers no recovery — title:null, aria-label:null — while the card's own name span one file over carries :title="palette.name". Combined with P2-1, the full name is unobtainable anywhere in the card UI on mobile.
defects.evidence: probe-D6-pass2-results.json header: {"text":"Muted Terracotta and Deep Sea Foam Study","title":null,"ariaLabel":null,"scrollW":319,"clientW":178,"color":"rgb(112, 89, 66)","fontSize":"14.384px"} -> 178/319 = 55.8%. Recovery idiom present at PaletteCard.vue:57 (`:title="palette.name"`). Rendered contrast of the header ink is 5.07:1 vs 13.49:1 for the ordinary action rows (probe-D8-pass2-results.json).
defects.mechanism: DropdownMenuLabel at PaletteCardMenu.vue:9 uses `truncate max-w-[180px]` with no title binding. The identity is simultaneously the smallest text in the panel (14.384px vs 16.4px items), the lowest-contrast text in the panel (5.07:1, 2.66x less contrasty than the actions it heads), and the only clipped one — inverting the hierarchy VISUAL-CONSTITUTION.md §4 assigns it.
defects.reproduction: Dev server up; `node docs/.../probe-D6-pass2.mjs` — the header arm reads title/aria-label/scrollWidth/clientWidth off .dropdown-menu__label with a 40-character seeded palette name.
defects.proposedCure: Do not solve it with a tooltip — PROPORTION-AUDIT.md §5 law 6 says subtraction precedes explanation and forbids tooltip proliferation. The identity belongs at --type-subheading in a region wide enough to hold it: the selected inspector, per P2-1.

defects.defect: The open-state API is spelled just off the Vue convention in a way that makes v-model structurally impossible: prop `menuOpen` + emit `updateOpen` instead of defineModel<boolean>("open").
defects.evidence: PaletteCardMenu.vue:206-227 declares `menuOpen: boolean` in defineProps and `updateOpen: [value: boolean]` in defineEmits; PaletteCard.vue:83-90 wires `:menu-open="menuOpen" @update-open="menuOpen = $event"`. Contrast: PalettesPane.vue:101 uses the idiomatic `<Dialog v-model:open="pm.showDeleteAllConfirm.value">` on a glass-ui primitive.
defects.mechanism: Vue's two-way binding keys on the `update:` prefix. `updateOpen` is not `update:open`, so v-model:open cannot bind and the parent must hand-wire the round trip. Breaches the idiomatic-Vue-3.5 edict; also spreads a bespoke API across two files for a state only one of them reads (PaletteCard.vue:281 sets it false inside startRenaming).
defects.reproduction: NONE — static (this is a shape defect, not a runtime failure).
defects.proposedCure: `const open = defineModel<boolean>("open")` and `<PaletteCardMenu v-model:open="menuOpen">`. Under P2-1's transposition the state disappears with the overlay.

defects.defect: copyAll is a MISSING AFFORDANCE, not merely dead code: the parent implements copy-all-colours and the menu never gives it a row, so the only copy path on a card is the hover-only swatch popover the constitution explicitly abrogates.
defects.evidence: `grep -rn "copyAll" demo` -> single hit, demo/palettes/browser/card/PaletteCard/PaletteCard.vue:294: `copyAll: () => void writeClipboard(props.palette.colors.map((c) => c.css).join(", ")),` — a working handler with zero producers. The surviving copy route is PaletteCard.vue:139-157's hover popover (@popover-copy -> writeClipboard at :331-334). VISUAL-CONSTITUTION.md:102: 'The card body owns no ... hover-only swatch-action path.'
defects.mechanism: The stringly-typed bus lets a handler exist with no caller and no compile error. Design-wise, copying a palette's colours is the most ordinary act in a colour tool; the affordance was built, never surfaced, and the abrogated hover path is what fills the gap. PROPORTION-AUDIT.md PR-07 ('Hover-only/unlabeled controls ... ADD-AFFORDANCE / REMOVE') is the governing row and half of it has been built.
defects.reproduction: NONE — static (grep above plus source read).
defects.proposedCure: Close PR-07 as one move rather than adding a row to a menu that is itself abrogated: retire the hover swatch-action path and give copy a named seat in the selected inspector's action region alongside the other lifecycle verbs.

defects.defect: The version count is rendered twice, roughly 40px apart, in two different type registers — a bare glyph chip on the card row and a labelled row in the menu.
defects.evidence: PaletteCardMeta.vue:26-33 renders ` {{ palette.versionCount }}` at text-micro/text-muted-foreground with title="4 versions". PaletteCardMenu.vue:93-102 renders `Versions` + `{{ palette.versionCount }}`. Both visible simultaneously in evidence/desktop-light-menu-open.png (card row `⏱4`, menu row `Versions 4`).
defects.mechanism: Two components independently decided the same datum was worth surfacing, in two registers, with no shared owner. PROPORTION-AUDIT.md §5 law 6: 'Subtraction precedes explanation.'
defects.reproduction: NONE — static, corroborated by the pass-1 evidence screenshot.
defects.proposedCure: One owner for one datum. The chip is the persistent entity status (it belongs on the card); the menu row is a navigation verb whose count is decoration. Drop the count from the verb, or under P2-1 move the verb to the inspector where the full history is the thing being navigated to.

defects.defect: The five export labels use three different naming conventions and none names the file you receive; 'Tailwind Config' actively misdescribes an artifact the byte contract forbids from being a config.
defects.evidence: PaletteCardMenu.vue:113 'JSON', :116 'CSS Custom Properties', :119 'Tailwind Config', :123 'SVG Swatch', :126 'PNG Swatch'. PALETTE-CONTRACT.md:213-229 fixes the stems and extensions exactly (`<slug>--r<n>.json|.css|.tailwind.json|.svg|.png`). PALETTE-CONTRACT.md:266: 'Tailwind export is data, not executable JavaScript... V emits no CommonJS/ESM function, comment, plugin, require, eval or configuration side effect.' PALETTE-CONTRACT.md:325 requires the seat to expose 'Download FILENAME'.
defects.mechanism: Three conventions in five adjacent rows (bare format / format+medium / format+artifact) and a promise the serializer is contractually forbidden to keep. Rows that name neither extension nor filename are the opposite of the contract's named seat.
defects.reproduction: NONE — static, quoted spec vs quoted source.
defects.proposedCure: The contract already wrote the label: a two-activation seat whose second state reads 'Download <exact filename>'. Implement that seat in the inspector (PROPORTION-AUDIT.md PR-08, durable operation state) rather than renaming five rows in an overlay that closes on activation.

defects.defect: The two panels of one menu disagree simultaneously on width, font-size, font-style and icon gutter — four register breaks between a parent and its own submenu.
defects.evidence: probe-D7-pass2-results.json submenu.panels: parent {w:192, fontSize:"16.4px", fontStyle:"normal", borderRadius:"12px"}; sub {w:242, fontSize:"14.384px", fontStyle:"italic", borderRadius:"12px"}. Icon gutter 32px vs 8px (submenu.items). Border-radius is the sole agreement.
defects.mechanism: Two of the four follow from one class chosen for a size it does not deliver: `class="text-caption"` on DropdownMenuSubContent (:112) has its font-size overridden by `.dropdown-menu__item{font-size:var(--dropdown-text)}` while its `font-style: italic` inherits through. The width divergence is `w-48` (192px, :7) pinned on the parent against a content-sized child; the gutter divergence is P2-5.
defects.reproduction: Dev server up; `node docs/.../probe-D7-pass2.mjs` — hovers the Export sub-trigger and dumps computed style plus rects for every [role=menu].
defects.proposedCure: Stop writing utilities the producer's own rules will eat or invert; glass-ui already ships `.text-dropdown` / `.text-dropdown-secondary` for exactly this context and they are unused. Root-level: the sub-content should inherit the parent panel's register from the producer, not from a consumer class (relay to glass-ui).

defects.defect: The 'temporary' arm is a three-row menu with no way to discard the palette — the ephemeral Generate/Mix/Extract outputs are the only kind the menu cannot dismiss — and the visible trash glyph is a different scope entirely (delete ALL saved).
defects.evidence: v-if enumeration for paletteKind==="temporary": Save (:15-22) renders, Rename (:73, `paletteKind !== 'remote'`) renders, Export (:107-130, unconditional) renders; Publish (:28 requires 'saved'), visibility (:49 requires remote), fork (:64), editTags (:84), versions (:94 requires !isLocal), Delete (:134 requires saved || remote&&isOwned), Report (:144), Admin (:153) all false. The floating trash in evidence/desktop-light-menu-open.png opens PalettesPane.vue:101-118 'Delete all saved palettes?'.
defects.mechanism: Two destructive owners at two scopes, and the scope the user is looking at has none. PROPORTION-AUDIT.md PR-06: 'Three adjacent action species or duplicated selected fills -> REMOVE. One action/selection owner.'
defects.reproduction: NONE — static enumeration of the template's v-if predicates against demo/palettes/utils.ts:20-30.
defects.proposedCure: One destruction owner per scope, in the selected inspector, with the confirmation step the menu cannot host (PROPORTION-AUDIT.md §5 law 2: at most one persistent action/status region per card).

defects.defect: CORROBORATION of pass-1 D-2 at the pixel level: the destructive Delete row and the neutral Rename row are separated by one unit of blue out of 255 in rendered pixels.
defects.evidence: probe-D8-pass2-results.json, light, rendered-pixel sampling: renameInk rgb(28,25,23) contrast 13.49:1; deleteInk rgb(28,24,22) contrast 13.59:1; deleteVsRenameDeltaE_approx = 1. Dark arm delta = 11, still sub-threshold at 16px text. Pass 1 reached the same conclusion by computed style and isolated the cascade: glass-ui's `.dropdown-menu__item{color:inherit}` beats `.text-destructive` (equal specificity 0,1,0) on source order.
defects.mechanism: PaletteCardMenu.vue:135 and :164 write `text-destructive focus:text-destructive`; the producer's `color:inherit` eats it. The severity ladder (destructive / neutral / de-emphasised, the last at :145) collapses to one ink. Combined with P2-6 (no separator) and the absence of any confirmation step in the menu, the irreversible row has neither chromatic, structural nor procedural distinction.
defects.reproduction: Dev server up; `node docs/.../probe-D8-pass2.mjs` — screenshots the open menu, decodes to canvas, samples darkest ink in the Rename and Delete row rects.
defects.proposedCure: The producer must own the axis: a `variant?: "default" | "destructive"` seam on glass-ui's DropdownMenuItem (relay to the glass-ui BH inbox per the standing fond). Consumers must stop writing colour utilities that `color:inherit` is guaranteed to eat. Structurally, per P2-1, destruction moves to the inspector where it can carry confirmation as well as ink.

result.axis: CHALLENGE-C — implementation defect hunt (PalettesPane, pass 2)
result.modelObserved: Opus 5 — exact model id claude-opus-5[1m] (1M-context variant). Spawned with an explicit Opus 5 declaration; served tier matches. No inheritance, no undeclared seat.

defects.defect: The FIRST drag-reorder after every page load silently scrambles the entire persisted palette library. `useSortable(sortableEl, pm.filteredSaved.value, …)` passes the computed's LIVE CACHED array (with an empty query `useFilteredList` returns `items.value` by identity, and `savedPalettes` is a `.filter()` computed). VueUse's default `onUpdate` is NOT displaced by the supplied `onEnd`, so `moveArrayElement` splices that same array in place (synchronous removal, `nextTick` re-insert); SortableJS dispatches `update` BEFORE `end`; the component's `onEnd` then re-reads `pm.filteredSaved.value` — now n−1 with the dragged item missing — and splices it by the ORIGINAL DOM indices before persisting via `reorderPalettes`.
defects.evidence: demo/palettes/PalettesPane.vue:183 + :187-196; useFilteredList.ts:10; usePaletteStore.ts:51-55; node_modules/@vueuse/integrations/dist/useSortable.js:14-16,23-26,82-90; node_modules/sortablejs/modular/sortable.esm.js:2002-2008 (update) then :2023-2027 (end). LIVE headless Chromium (PPC-probe1.mjs / PPC-probe2.mjs): `P1 store BEFORE : Alpha Beta Gamma Delta` / `P1 store AFTER  : Gamma Delta Beta Alpha` / `P1 EXPECTED (drag idx0 -> idx2): Beta Gamma Alpha Delta` / `P1 pageErrors: 0`. Second instance, 6 palettes, drag 0→1: `I after warm-up drag: Gamma Beta Delta Zed1 Zed2 Alpha` — both exactly as the mechanism predicts. CONTROL proving aliasing is the cause: force one store write first so the computed recomputes a new array, and the identical gesture is correct — `P2 store AFTER : Beta Gamma Alpha Delta Zeta  == EXPECTED`. Same-session sequence: `A t1 (1st drag 0->2): Gamma Delta Beta Alpha` WRONG, `A t2` and `A t3` correct.
defects.mechanism: aliased-derived-value mutation — a read-only computed's cached array handed to a library that owns and mutates its list, with two writers (library default onUpdate + component onEnd) racing across one Sortable event sequence
defects.reproduction: Seed localStorage["color-palettes"] with 4 local palettes, load http://localhost:9000/#/palettes, do NOT type in the search box, drag card 0's `.drag-handle` onto card 2 with real mouse down/move/up. Store order becomes `Gamma Delta Beta Alpha` instead of `Beta Gamma Alpha Delta`. Repeat the same drag: correct from the 2nd onward.
defects.proposedCure: Stop handing Sortable a derived list at all — it can never satisfy the library's "I own and mutate this list" contract, as a value OR as a ref. Call `useSortable(sortableEl, [], { handle, animation, ghostClass, onUpdate(evt){ … } })` and own the move explicitly in `onUpdate` (the hook the library reserves for the reorder), translating the DOM move into a move over `pm.savedPalettes.value` and passing the FULL id list to `reorderPalettes`. `onEnd` is a lifecycle notification, not a mutation site; doing the work there while leaving `onUpdate` at its default is what created two writers to one array.

defects.defect: `PalettesPane`'s `commitEdit` / `cancelEdit` emits never reach a handler — the pane's own "Save edit" and "Cancel edit" buttons are inert dead controls. The sole call site builds props in JS with kebab-cased handler keys (`"onCommit-edit"`, `"onCancel-edit"`), which Vue's emit resolver never matches; they fall through to the DOM as listeners for custom events named `commit-edit`/`cancel-edit` that nothing dispatches.
defects.evidence: demo/palettes/PalettesPane.vue:51-52,158-161; demo/shell/usePaneRouter.ts:153-158; node_modules/@vue/runtime-core/dist/runtime-core.cjs.js:4415-4418 (only `toHandlerKey(event)` and `toHandlerKey(camelize(event))` are tried; the `hyphenate` fallback is gated on `isModelListener = event.startsWith("update:")`). jsdom + repo's own vue 3.5.35 (emit-key.mjs): `SUBJECT attrs seen by pane: ["savedColorStrings","onCommit-edit","onCancel-edit"]` / `log after both clicks: ["HANDLER FIRED (camel key)"]` / `RESULT: kebab prop key IS DEAD`. LIVE app (PPC-probe3.mjs) addEventListener instrumentation: `[{"type":"commit-edit","target":"div."},{"type":"cancel-edit","target":"div."}]`. LIVE UI flow (PPC-probe4.mjs): `F2 after Edit click: {"overlays":1,"paneSave":1}` → `F4 after PANE Save-edit click: {"overlays":1,"paneSave":1}` (nothing happened) → `F6 after DOCK Save-edit click: {"overlays":0,"paneSave":0}` (control works, wired via App.vue:41-42 template listener).
defects.mechanism: untyped `Record<string, unknown>` prop bag across a component boundary erases the emit contract, allowing a handler key no component can ever receive
defects.reproduction: Seed localStorage["color-picker"]={"inputColor":"#3366ff","savedColors":["#ff0000","#00ff00"]}, load /#/palettes at ≥1024px, hover the first Current-Palette swatch, click "Edit color …", then click the ✓ "Save edit" button inside `.edit-overlay`. Nothing happens; the overlay stays open. Clicking the dock's identically-labelled "Save edit" closes it.
defects.proposedCure: The composition root must speak the component's contract instead of hand-approximating it. Type the pane slot props against the component (`ComponentProps<typeof PalettesPane>`) so `"onCommit-edit"` fails to compile, or move the two listeners into the template beside the ones that already work in App.vue. `rightProps(): Record<string, unknown>` (usePaneRouter.ts:120) is the defect; the kebab keys are the symptom.

defects.defect: A drag performed while a search filter is active hoists every match to the head of the persisted library and pushes every non-match to the tail: `onEnd` hands `reorderPalettes` the FILTERED id list, and `reorderPalettes` treats it as the complete new order, appending everything unnamed at the tail.
defects.evidence: demo/palettes/PalettesPane.vue:190-195; demo/palettes/usePaletteStore.ts:153-167 (esp. :163-165 the append loop). LIVE (PPC-probe6.mjs probe I, alias deliberately broken first so this isolates the filter bug): `I after warm-up drag: Gamma Beta Delta Zed1 Zed2 Alpha` / `I visible under q='zed': ["Palette: Zed1","Palette: Zed2"]` / `I store AFTER filtered drag: Zed2 Zed1 Gamma Beta Delta Alpha` — four untouched palettes moved two places.
defects.mechanism: projection/total-order conflation — a gesture over a filtered view written back as if it were the complete order
defects.reproduction: Seed 6 palettes (Alpha..Delta, Zed1, Zed2), load /#/palettes, drag once to break the C-1 alias, type 'zed' in the pane SearchBar, drag Zed1 onto Zed2. Clear the search: Zed2 and Zed1 are now first in the whole library.
defects.proposedCure: Either withdraw the drag affordance while `pm.searchQuery.value` is non-empty (KISS, and honest until reorder-under-filter is a designed behaviour), or translate the projection move into a base move: find the dragged id and the target neighbour id in `pm.savedPalettes.value`, splice there, and pass the FULL id list to `reorderPalettes`.

defects.defect: One malformed colour string in the store tears down the entire pane on card expand, and it is a CLASS not an instance — `oklch()`, `color()`, `lab()` and `rgb()` (any empty-argument functional form) each collapse the subtree into ErrorBoundary, contributing ZERO additional console or page-error signal.
defects.evidence: PPC-probe7.mjs, one fresh browser context per row: `CONTROL_valid before=1 after=1 grid=true boundary=false pageErr=0 consoleErr=1` / `oklch_empty before=1 after=0 grid=false boundary=true pageErr=0 consoleErr=1` / `color_empty … boundary=true` / `lab_empty … boundary=true` / `rgb_empty … boundary=true` / `zero_colors … boundary=false`. consoleErr=1 on the CONTROL too (pre-existing dev-API error), so the crash adds no signal. Ingress: demo/palettes/useBrowsePalettes.ts onSaveRemote → usePaletteStore.ts:121-151 addPublishedPalette spreads an unvalidated server row; the serializer at usePaletteStore.ts:23-31 validates only `typeof parsed.version === "number"`.
defects.mechanism: no shape/colour validation at the single store ingress choke point + pane-level (not card-level) error isolation, so one bad row is a total-loss single point of failure
defects.reproduction: Set localStorage["color-palettes"] to a store whose single palette has colors [{css:"lab()"}], load /#/palettes, click the card. `.palette-card-grid` becomes null and the body reads "This panel hit an unexpected error."
defects.proposedCure: Validate once at the serializer `read()` — the one honest choke point for every store ingress — so `PaletteStore` is a real type rather than a cast (shape + per-colour `CSS.supports("color", css)`), and route `addPublishedPalette` through the same validator. Then wrap the CARD, not the pane, in the ErrorBoundary the repo already owns so one bad palette costs one row.

defects.defect: `searchQuery` is one app-global ref shared by the library, browse, admin and colour-queue ports — typing in the Palettes pane filters the public Browse commons and vice-versa. The component's own comment (PalettesPane.vue:28-32) asserts the opposite: "the twin placeholder … is scoped — this one owns YOUR list."
defects.evidence: demo/palettes/usePalettePorts.ts:54 (one `const searchQuery = ref("")`) handed to :112 filteredSaved, :139 libraryPort, :183 browsePort, :224 adminPort, :69 colorQueue. LIVE (PPC-probe2.mjs probe C) — type in Palettes, navigate to /#/browse: `[{"ph":"enter slug or token...","v":""},{"ph":"Search the commons...","v":"zzzzleak"},{"ph":"Search your palettes...","v":"zzzzleak"}]`.

defects.reproduction: Load /#/palettes, type 'zzzzleak' into "Search your palettes...", navigate to /#/browse — the "Search the commons..." input carries the same value and filters the remote list.
defects.proposedCure: Each port owns its own `searchQuery` ref (library / browse / admin as three distinct refs). The `searchPlaceholder` computed at usePalettePorts.ts:104-110, which switches placeholder text on `currentView`, is the fossil of the single-search-box era and dies with it. Delete the comment: an in-file claim contradicted by the code it annotates is worse than none.

defects.defect: A search that matches nothing renders the empty-LIBRARY plate — "No saved palettes yet. / Add colors above, then save the set." — beside a header badge reading the true count, with the Delete-all trigger still live and still destroying ALL saved palettes.

Screenshot PPC-desktop-nomatch.png: badge "5" directly above "No saved palettes yet."

defects.reproduction: Seed 3+ palettes, load /#/palettes, type 'zzzznomatch' into the SearchBar.

Gate the delete-all trigger on the same predicate the grid uses.

defects.defect: `cardRefs` never releases an unmounted PaletteCard: the `:ref` callback's `el &&` short-circuit discards the `null` Vue passes on unmount, so the map grows monotonically with palette churn and retains full component instance proxies (effect scopes, useLiquidPress/useHoverPopover closures) until page reload.
defects.evidence: demo/palettes/PalettesPane.vue:84 `:ref="(el: any) => el && (cardRefs[palette.id] = el)"` and :177. LIVE, reading `setupState.cardRefs` through `__vue_app__`: (PPC-probe5.mjs G4) `after filtering to 0 cards: {"cards":0,"cardRefKeys":[6]}`; (PPC-probe6.mjs H, only 2 cards ever rendered) `[{round:0,cards:2,refs:2},{1,2,4},{2,2,6},{3,2,8},{4,2,10},{5,2,12}]`.
defects.mechanism: instance-reaching parent→child map with no release path; `reactive()` on it is additionally inert since nothing reads it in a render
defects.reproduction: Load /#/palettes with 2 palettes, then repeatedly replace the store with 2 fresh-UUID palettes; `cardRefs` key count grows 2,4,6,8,10,12 while the DOM holds 2 cards.
defects.proposedCure: Delete the map. Move the feedback into the port as `feedbackFor: Ref<{id,message,variant}|null>` in usePaletteActions and let PaletteCard render ActionFeedback from a prop — data down, no instance reaching. That removes the map, both `any` casts, PaletteCard's imperative `defineExpose({ showFeedback })` (PaletteCard.vue:244) and C-7 in one move.

defects.defect: `onPublish` writes publish feedback into a possibly-unmounted card after an un-revalidated await, and — because of C-6 — `cardRefs[id]` is ALWAYS truthy, so the `if (card)` guard whose sole purpose is to detect that condition can never fail. Success and failure messages are silently lost when the card unmounts mid-flight.
defects.evidence: demo/palettes/PalettesPane.vue:199-209 — `const result = await pm.onPublish(palette); … const card = cardRefs[id]; if (card) { card.showFeedback(...) }`, with cardRefs retention proven in C-6 (cardRefKeys stayed 6 while cards was 0).
defects.mechanism: unguarded async continuation into a child instance handle, with the guard defeated by the same leak that makes the handle stale
defects.reproduction: NONE as a standalone measurement this pass — the retention half is measured (C-6) and the code path is unambiguous; the lost-message half was measured by the pass-1 seat (RACE chips after remount: []).
defects.proposedCure: Subsumed by C-6's cure: state that must survive an unmount belongs in the port, not in a child instance the parent pokes. If the imperative shape were kept, the guard would have to be `if (card && !card.$.isUnmounted)` — a patch on a design that should not reach into instances at all.

defects.defect: Drag-reorder — a real, persisted feature — is reachable only by mouse/touch drag: the handle is a bare non-focusable 16×16 `<svg>` with no role, tabindex or accessible name, and the card menu offers no Move up/Move down alternative.

defects.reproduction: Load /#/palettes with 5 saved palettes; Tab through the pane — only the 5 "Palette menu" buttons receive focus; no reorder path exists.

If the pattern recurs, it belongs in glass-ui as a `DragHandle` primitive, not as a demo-local one-off.

defects.defect: `PaletteCardGrid` declares `role="list"` while every child PaletteCard declares `role="article"` — zero required owned `listitem` elements; in the empty state the grid's only owned child is the EmptyState status region.

defects.reproduction: Load /#/palettes with 5 saved palettes; query `[role=listitem]` inside the pane → 0.
defects.proposedCure: The card is the wrong one: a saved palette is an item in a collection, not an independently syndicable composition. `PaletteCard` → `role="listitem"` (keeping its aria-label); EmptyState moves outside the list element; `article` survives only where a card renders standalone.

defects.defect: The pane has no live region at all — publish success/failure is announced to nobody. ActionFeedback renders a plain div with no role="status" and no aria-live.

defects.reproduction: Load /#/palettes with cards; `pane.querySelectorAll('[aria-live],[role=status],[role=alert]').length === 0`.
defects.proposedCure: `role="status"` on the feedback chip (it is exactly a status message), and — once C-6's cure lands — one pane-level status region rather than one per card.

defects.defect: Export failures are swallowed into `console.warn` with no user-visible signal, on a user-initiated action, in a pane that has no live region to carry one anyway.

defects.reproduction: NONE run this pass — the catch block is unconditional and has no user-facing branch; this is a code-read finding.

defects.defect: Per-instance restyle of a design-system Button — a hand-rolled quiet-destructive register in utilities — refuted 49 lines later in the same file by `<Button tone="destructive">`.

defects.defect: Three dead imports (`watch`, `onMounted`, `nextTick`) — the fossil of a removed lifecycle block — invisible to BOTH gates, which are configured off for this class (a vacuous-gate finding in its own right).

defects.defect: `reorderPalettes` is O(n²) — `orderedIds.includes(p.id)` inside a loop over all palettes.

result.strongestDefect: C-1 — the first drag-reorder after every page load silently and irreversibly scrambles the entire persisted palette library (`Alpha Beta Gamma Delta` → `Gamma Delta Beta Alpha`, measured, 0 page errors, 0 console errors, written through to localStorage), and is correct on every subsequent drag in the same session. That heisenbug shape is exactly why it shipped: a developer who drags twice sees it work, no test can see it, and the one prior audit that looked directly at the line (pass-1 D-9) ruled it a harmless MINOR — "the mutation can never be observed", "reordering happens to work". This pass overturns that with a measurement plus a control that isolates the aliasing as the cause.
result.negativeProof: N/A — verdict is DEFECTIVE. (Negative results that ARE proven, so no seat re-runs them: no defineModel in the component; no ValueUnit wrapping; no stableHue/oklch→HSV path; no rAF; no WebGL; no reka-ui slider. Double-mount in both responsive slots was HYPOTHESISED AND REFUTED — PPC-probe5.mjs G1 measured {"grids":1,"visibleGrids":1,"searchYourPalettes":1,"deleteAllTriggers":1} and G3 found exactly 1 PalettesPane component instance via __vue_app__, so there is no duplicate Dialog and no duplicate Sortable. Horizontal overflow refuted at both breakpoints with an over-long palette name: desktop {"docScrollW":1600,"clientW":1600}, mobile {"docScrollW":390,"clientW":390}. Nameless buttons in this pane: [] measured with 5 cards. Zero-colour palette renders without incident. Confirm-dialog focus placement and restoration measured correct. verbatimModuleSyntax satisfied.)

result.axis: CHALLENGE-C — implementation audit (pass 2) of demo/palettes/browser/card/PaletteCard/PaletteCardMenu.vue
result.modelObserved: Opus 5 — model id `claude-opus-5[1m]` (1M-context variant). Declared at spawn, not inherited.

defects.defect: 22 menu-item instances across 3 of the 5 host sites are wired to nothing — including the destructive `Delete`. The menu emits `action: [action: string]`, PaletteCard re-emits 17 separate events, and Vue silently drops emits with no listener. MixSourceSelector binds none, ExtractWorkbench binds 2 of 7, AdminUsersPanel binds 2 of 11.
defects.evidence: PaletteCardMenu.vue:224-227 (`action: [action: string]`); PaletteCard.vue:315-316 (`const fn = actions[action]; if (!fn) return;`); MixSourceSelector.vue:264-267 (no listeners). LIVE with matched control — probe pcm-p2-f.mjs on /#/mix: `::mix_storeBefore 8` → `::mix_afterDelete {"storeN":8,"cards":8,"feedback":null,"dialog":null,"menusInDom":0}`; control probe pcm-p2-e.mjs on /#/palettes: `::E2_afterDelete {articles:7}` `::E2_storeN 7` (8→7). Export: `::mix_downloads []` vs `::palettes_downloads_CONTROL ["probe-palette-0.json"]`.
defects.mechanism: untyped stringly action contract + a masking `if (!fn) return` swallow + per-host `@`-binding, so item liveness is a property of files the component never sees and nothing checks
defects.reproduction: npm run dev; seed localStorage["color-palettes"]={version:1,palettes:[8 local palettes]}; open http://localhost:9000/#/mix; click the in-pane "Palettes" source toggle; open any card's `Palette menu`; click Delete. The store and the card grid are unchanged, no feedback, no console line. Same click at /#/palettes deletes the palette.
defects.proposedCure: Two halves. (1) Declare `export type PaletteCardAction = …` once, type the emit with it, and make the parent map `Record<PaletteCardAction, () => void>` — exhaustive, so `if (!fn) return` is deleted and the dead `copyAll` handler becomes a compile error. (2) The real cure: the menu must not offer items its host cannot service — derive the item list from a capability set the host declares (or from the handlers it provides), so MixSourceSelector's selection card renders no menu at all rather than eight inert verbs.

defects.defect: `@click.prevent` on the Export sub-trigger makes the entire Export submenu (JSON/CSS/Tailwind/SVG/PNG) unreachable by touch and by click; only mouse-hover and keyboard escape it.
defects.evidence: PaletteCardMenu.vue:108 `<DropdownMenuSubTrigger class="gap-2 cursor-pointer" @click.prevent>`. reka guard: node_modules/reka-ui/dist/Menu/MenuSubTrigger.js `onClick: async (event) => { if (props.disabled || event.defaultPrevented) return; … }`. Merge order: node_modules/reka-ui/dist/Primitive/Slot.js:16 `mergeProps(attrs, firstNonCommentChildren.props)` (consumer first). Touch dead for hover: node_modules/reka-ui/dist/Menu/utils.js `isMouseEvent(event){return event.pointerType==="mouse";}`. LIVE probe pcm-p2-b.mjs: touch tap → `{"ariaExpanded":"false","menuCount":1}`, 4 items; mouse hover → `{"ariaExpanded":"true","menuCount":2}`, 9 items. Only sub-trigger in the demo: `grep -rn DropdownMenuSubTrigger demo --include=*.vue` → PaletteCardMenu.vue:108/111/188 only.
defects.mechanism: a fallthrough `.prevent` listener merged ahead of the primitive's own handler, which is guarded on `event.defaultPrevented`
defects.reproduction: probe pcm-p2-j.mjs (independent discriminator): dispatch the same MouseEvent twice at the sub-trigger. Plain → `::J1_plainClick {"defaultPreventedAfterDispatch":true}`, `::J1_after {"ariaExpanded":"false","itemCount":4}`. With `defaultPrevented` pinned false (neutralising only `.prevent`) → `::J2_after {"ariaExpanded":"true","dataState":"open","menuCount":2,"itemCount":9}` with all five export items enumerated. `data-disabled` is null in both runs, so `defaultPrevented` is the only branch that can bail.
defects.proposedCure: Delete the modifier: `<DropdownMenuSubTrigger class="gap-2 cursor-pointer">`. `preventDefault` on a `div[role=menuitem]` suppresses no browser default, and "don't close the menu" is already the primitive's behaviour for a sub-trigger (it never emits ITEM_SELECT). Strict simplification, not a trade.

defects.defect: The Export items write attacker-controlled markup to the user's disk, and fail silently at the empty-collection boundary. `exportAsSVG` interpolates `c.css` and `palette.name` raw into SVG attributes and text.
defects.evidence: demo/palettes/export.ts:63-80 (`fill="${c.css}"`, `>${palette.name}<`); silent swallow at demo/palettes/usePaletteExport.ts:22-24 `catch (e) { console.warn("Export failed:", e); }`. API accepts anything: api/src/modules/palette/schema.ts:28 `css: z.string().min(1).max(200)` — no colour grammar. LIVE probe pcm-p2-i.mjs downloaded `ampersand-tag-quote.svg` containing `<rect … fill="#00ddaa" onload="alert(1)" />` and an unescaped `&`/`<tag>` in the text node. Empty palette: `::EMPTY_png {"downloads":[],"newWarnings":["Export failed: Error: Failed to create PNG blob at …/export.ts:83:13"]}`; `::EMPTY_svg` downloaded a `width="0"` file.
defects.mechanism: string-concatenation markup generation with no escaping, plus a catch-all console.warn that turns every failure into silence while an unused ActionFeedback channel sits on the same card
defects.reproduction: Seed a local palette named `Ampersand & <tag> "quote"` with a colour `#00ddaa" onload="alert(1)`; open its card menu → Export → SVG Swatch. The downloaded SVG contains the injected `onload` handler. Then Export → PNG Swatch: nothing downloads, only `console.warn`. Separately, seed a palette with `colors: []` and Export → PNG Swatch: nothing downloads. Reachable from another user's data because the public API stores any ≤200-char string as a colour.
defects.proposedCure: Build the SVG with `document.createElementNS` + `setAttribute` instead of template concatenation — unbreakable by construction and no more code. Guard `colors.length === 0` before offering the raster/vector items. Route every `catch` in `usePaletteExport` into the card's existing `showFeedback(msg, "error")` (already exposed at PaletteCard.vue:244) so a failed export is a state, not silence.

defects.defect: `apiOffline = availability.value === "unavailable"` reads a 4-state latch with one equality, so the `misconfigured` state leaves Publish enabled, un-annotated, and producing a wrong error.
defects.evidence: PaletteCardMenu.vue:216-217; the enum at demo/platform/transport/availability.ts:40-44 (`unknown|available|unavailable|misconfigured`). LIVE on the dev server (probe pcm-p2-a.mjs): console error confirms `misconfigured`, and `::AX_menuItems [… {"role":"menuitem","name":"Publish","disabled":null} …]`, `::items […{"text":"Publish","ariaDisabled":null,"dataDisabled":null,"pe":"auto"}…]`. Clicking it (probe pcm-p2-b.mjs) → `::afterPublishVisibleFeedback "Failed to create session"`. POSITIVE CONTROL (probe pcm-p2-h.mjs, latch forced to `unavailable`): `::itemsUnderUnavailableLatch [{"text":"Publish offline","ariaDisabled":"true","dataDisabled":"","pe":"none"} …]`. The law is already codified: test/status-lamp.test.ts:88 `it("misconfigured ≠ unavailable — distinct variants AND distinct roles")`; the sibling consumer derives both at ApiOfflineChip.vue:35-37.
defects.mechanism: a 4-state enum flattened by hand at each consumer instead of once at the seam that owns it; three consumers re-derive the same booleans and the newest one got it wrong
defects.reproduction: Open http://localhost:9000/#/palettes (no VITE_API_URL → latch is `misconfigured`, proven by the loud console.error). Open any saved palette's card menu: Publish renders enabled with no annotation. Click it: the feedback chip reads "Failed to create session" — neither the misconfig nor an offline message. Contrast probe pcm-p2-h.mjs where a real network failure disables it and annotates "offline".
defects.proposedCure: Move the predicate to `useApiClient()` — expose the derived `degraded` plus the *reason* once, so every affordance reads one source and the annotation can name which degradation it is. That kills the drift class; a local `|| "misconfigured"` patch only kills this instance.

defects.defect: `isPublic = palette.visibility !== "private"` collapses a 3-state enum: an `unlisted` palette renders byte-identically to a public one and is offered an action that destroys the middle state with no path back.
defects.evidence: PaletteCardMenu.vue:222; demo/palettes/types.ts:39-40 `visibility?: "public"|"unlisted"|"private"`; canonical predicate is `=== "public"` (api/src/modules/palette/format.ts:86). Both sides promise preservation: demo/palettes/api/palettes.ts:128-130 and api/src/modules/palette/service/visibility.ts:7-8. The lossy contract is declared at PaletteCard.vue:212 `setVisibility: [palette, "public"|"private"]`. LIVE (probe pcm-p2-g.mjs): `[UNLISTED palette] -> Save | Make private public | Remix | …` — identical to `[PUBLIC palette]`. AX name: `"Make private PUBLIC"`.
defects.mechanism: a ternary domain modelled as a boolean by negating the wrong member, so two distinct states alias
defects.reproduction: Serve the dev server over its LAN host (non-loopback ⇒ detectDevMisconfig false ⇒ requests are really issued), seed localStorage["palette-user-slug"]="probeuser", and page.route() the browse feed to return owned remote palettes with visibility public/unlisted/private/undefined. Open /#/browse and each card's menu: the unlisted row reads "Make private" annotated "public", character-for-character the same as the public row. Full script at evidence/pass-2/pcm-p2-g.mjs.
defects.proposedCure: `=== "public"` fixes the alias, but the idiomatic cure is to stop modelling a ternary as a toggle: annotate the actual value (public/unlisted/private) and offer the transition that is missing, so the control is a state display + transition. The API treats all three as legal resting states; the UI is the only layer that flattened it.

defects.defect: Choosing `Rename` gives the inline input focus for 212 ms and then reka's close-time focus restoration takes it back to the menu trigger — the caret appears and vanishes, and the field is never announced.
defects.evidence: PaletteRenameInput.vue:53-56 focuses on mount; PaletteCard.vue:291-292 comments "keep the menu open visually until the input takes focus" but its guard at :317 `if (action !== "rename") menuOpen.value = false;` is dead because `startRenaming()` (:280-283) sets `menuOpen.value = false` on its own first line. LIVE (probe pcm-p2-b.mjs): `::focusLog [{t:6424, DIV .dropdown-menu__item},{t:6431, INPUT ph:"Palette name..."},{t:6643, BUTTON aria-label:"Palette menu"}]`; `::activeElementByFrame [{INPUT, firstFrame:0},{BUTTON "Palette menu", firstFrame:11}]`; `::finalActiveElement {"tag":"BUTTON","label":"Palette menu"}`; `::renameInputAxName {"placeholder":"Palette name...","ariaLabel":null,"labelled":false}`.
defects.mechanism: two focus authorities racing in the same flush — the newly mounted input's onMounted focus vs the dismissed menu's onCloseAutoFocus trigger-restore — with the intended mitigation present as a comment and dead as code
defects.reproduction: http://localhost:9000/#/palettes with a seeded local palette; open the card menu; click Rename. Watch the caret: it lands in the field and is pulled back to the `…` trigger ~212 ms later. Keyboard users must Tab/click into the field manually.
defects.proposedCure: Delete the dead guard and use the hook that exists for exactly this: `@close-auto-focus.prevent` on `DropdownMenuContent` for the rename path (or move focus in the nextTick after restoration rather than racing it). Also give the input a real accessible name — it currently has only a placeholder.

defects.defect: On /#/mix the PaletteCardMenu trigger is a native `<button>` nested inside another native `<button>` (the mix-source selection control) — 30 nested-interactive violations on one screen — and `role="article"` is nested there too.
defects.evidence: demo/workbenches/mix/MixSourceSelector.vue:250-268 (`<button type="button" :aria-pressed …><PaletteCard …/></button>`) wrapping PaletteCard.vue:96-104 (`<Button icon-only aria-label="Palette menu">`). Screenshot evidence/pass-2/mix-palettes-mode.png shows the `…` trigger on every row.
defects.mechanism: PaletteCard renders PaletteCardMenu unconditionally, so any host that wraps a card in its own interactive control inherits nested interactive content; the only thing preventing menu clicks from also toggling selection is a `@click.stop` in a different file (PaletteCard.vue:82)

defects.proposedCure: Same as C2-1: whether the action menu renders must be the host's decision, not an unconditional child of PaletteCard. A source-picker card carries no menu, which removes the nesting, the dead actions, and the fragile cross-file `@click.stop` in one move.

defects.defect: Vacuous gate, total: the repo has no component-test infrastructure at all, and zero e2e coverage of this menu's Export or visibility surfaces.
defects.evidence: `grep -rn "@vue/test-utils" test demo e2e` → no output (it is a declared but unimported devDependency). `grep -rln "mount(" test demo/test` → no output. vitest.config.ts includes `["test/**/*.ts","demo/test/**/*.ts"]` under jsdom; not one file mounts a Vue component. `grep -rn "Export\b" e2e --include=*.ts` → no output. `grep -rc "Make private|makePrivate|SVG Swatch|PNG Swatch|Tailwind Config" e2e -r` → no non-zero rows. Only two of seventeen items are asserted anywhere: palette-fork.spec.ts:48 (Remix) and o10d-display-voice-census.spec.ts:328 (Versions).
defects.mechanism: no gate exists at the altitude where this component's defects live (derived state and item composition), so every one of them is invisible to CI
defects.reproduction: Four one-line mutations that keep every gate green: (1) delete lines 107-130 — the whole export submenu; (2) `const isPublic = computed(() => true)`; (3) `const apiOffline = computed(() => false)`; (4) delete the `@delete` binding at PalettesPane.vue:88, which makes the last live Delete path as dead as /#/mix. defects.proposedCure: Extract the item table — a pure function `(kind, isOwned, isAdmin, availability, visibility) → items[{label, annotation, disabled, action, needsNetwork}]` — and unit-test it. It needs no DOM (reka menus do not render under this repo's jsdom), and it makes C2-4, C2-5, C2-9, C2-10 and C2-11 all directly assertable. Then one touch-emulated e2e spec that taps Export, which would have caught C2-2 the day it landed.

defects.defect: The K-INV5 state annotation is a child of the menuitem, so it concatenates into the item's accessible name: AT announces "Make private PUBLIC" and "Publish OFFLINE".
defects.evidence: PaletteCardMenu.vue:35-39 and :56-59 (annotation spans inside the DropdownMenuItem). CDP Accessibility.getFullAXTree — probe pcm-p2-g.mjs: `{"name":"Make private PUBLIC"}`; probe pcm-p2-h.mjs: `{"name":"Publish OFFLINE","disabled":true}`.
defects.mechanism: a visual register implemented as in-flow text with no separation between the presentational annotation and the item's computed name
defects.reproduction: Open any owned remote palette's card menu with the stubbed feed (evidence/pass-2/pcm-p2-g.mjs) and read the AX tree: the visibility item's name is the verb concatenated with a contradicting state word.
defects.proposedCure: Give the item an explicit `aria-label` that is the verb alone and mark the annotation `aria-hidden="true"` — implemented once in the glass-ui item primitive alongside the styling register (see C2-12), not per-instance here.

defects.defect: The availability latch gates 2 of ~9 network-bound menu actions; Delete, Remix, Versions, Report, Edit Tags, Feature and admin Delete all stay live and unannotated while the API is down.
defects.evidence: `:disabled="apiOffline"` appears only at PaletteCardMenu.vue:30 and :51. Handlers proven network-bound: BrowsePane.vue onDeleteOwned/onFork/onVersions/onFlag/onEditTags; useAdminUsers.ts:82-90 setPaletteFeatured.
